using Microsoft.Extensions.Localization;
using OfficeOpenXml;
using OfficeOpenXml.Style;

namespace FilistinProje.Web.Areas.Admin.Controllers
{
    [Area("Admin")]
    public class ZiyaretciController : AdminBaseController
    {
        private static readonly TimeZoneInfo PalestineTimeZone = ResolvePalestineTimeZone();
        private readonly KanvasDbContext _context;
        private readonly IStringLocalizer<SharedResource> _localizer;

        public ZiyaretciController(KanvasDbContext context, IStringLocalizer<SharedResource> localizer)
        {
            _context = context;
            _localizer = localizer;
        }

        public async Task<IActionResult> Index(
            string? q,
            string? metod,
            string? cihaz,
            DateTime? baslangic,
            DateTime? bitis,
            int page = 1,
            int pageSize = 20)
        {
            page = Math.Max(1, page);
            pageSize = NormalizePageSize(pageSize);

            var query = BuildFilteredQuery(q, metod, cihaz, baslangic, bitis);
            var totalCount = await query.CountAsync();
            var totalPages = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(totalCount / (double)pageSize));
            page = Math.Min(page, totalPages);

            var kayitlar = await query
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.OlusturulmaTarihi)
                .Skip((page - 1) * pageSize)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .ToListAsync();

            var utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;
            var palestineNow = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(utcNow, PalestineTimeZone);
            var todayStart = PalestineLocalDateToUtc(palestineNow.Date);
            var onlineStart = utcNow.AddMinutes(-5);

            var allLogsQuery = _context.ZiyaretciLoglari.AsNoTracking();
            var filteredLogs = await query.ToListAsync();

            var topPages = filteredLogs
                .Where(x => string.Equals(x.Metod, "GET", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .GroupBy(x => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.Url) ? "/" : x.Url)
                .Select(g => new ZiyaretciStatItem
                {
                    Etiket = g.Key,
                    Adet = g.Count(),
                    Tekil = g.Select(x => x.IpAdresi).Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x)).Distinct().Count()
                })
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.Adet)
                .Take(5)
                .ToList();

            var topSources = filteredLogs
                .GroupBy(x => NormalizeReferer(x.ReferansUrl))
                .Select(g => new ZiyaretciStatItem
                {
                    Etiket = g.Key,
                    Adet = g.Count(),
                    Tekil = g.Select(x => x.IpAdresi).Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x)).Distinct().Count()
                })
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.Adet)
                .Take(5)
                .ToList();

            var model = new ZiyaretciIndexViewModel
            {
                Kayitlar = kayitlar,
                Arama = q?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
                Metod = metod?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
                Cihaz = cihaz?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
                Baslangic = baslangic,
                Bitis = bitis,
                Page = page,
                PageSize = pageSize,
                TotalCount = totalCount,
                TotalPages = totalPages,
                OnlineSayisi = await allLogsQuery
                    .Where(x => x.OlusturulmaTarihi >= onlineStart)
                    .Select(x => x.IpAdresi)
                    .Distinct()
                    .CountAsync(),
                BugunTekil = await allLogsQuery
                    .Where(x => x.OlusturulmaTarihi >= todayStart)
                    .Select(x => x.IpAdresi)
                    .Distinct()
                    .CountAsync(),
                BugunZiyaret = await allLogsQuery.CountAsync(x => x.OlusturulmaTarihi >= todayStart),
                ToplamTekil = filteredLogs.Select(x => x.IpAdresi).Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x)).Distinct().Count(),
                MobilZiyaret = filteredLogs.Count(IsMobile),
                MasaustuZiyaret = filteredLogs.Count(x => !IsMobile(x)),
                EnCokGezilenSayfa = topPages.FirstOrDefault()?.Etiket ?? "-",
                EnGucluKaynak = topSources.FirstOrDefault()?.Etiket ?? "-",
                TopSayfalar = topPages,
                TopKaynaklar = topSources
            };

            return View(model);
        }

        public async Task<IActionResult> Export(string? q, string? metod, string? cihaz, DateTime? baslangic, DateTime? bitis)
        {
            var exportTime = ToPalestineLocal(DateTime.UtcNow);
            var kayitlar = await BuildFilteredQuery(q, metod, cihaz, baslangic, bitis)
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.OlusturulmaTarihi)
                .ToListAsync();

            using var package = new ExcelPackage();
            var worksheet = package.Workbook.Worksheets.Add(_localizer["Admin_VisitorTrafficWorksheet"].Value);
            var headers = new[]
            {
                _localizer["Admin_VisitorDate"].Value,
                _localizer["Admin_VisitorIpAddress"].Value,
                _localizer["Admin_VisitorCountry"].Value,
                _localizer["Admin_VisitorCity"].Value,
                _localizer["Admin_VisitorMethod"].Value,
                _localizer["Admin_VisitorUrl"].Value,
                _localizer["Admin_VisitorReferrer"].Value,
                _localizer["Admin_VisitorUser"].Value,
                _localizer["Admin_VisitorDevice"].Value,
                _localizer["Admin_VisitorBrowser"].Value,
                _localizer["Admin_VisitorOperatingSystem"].Value
            };

            for (var i = 0; i < headers.Length; i++)
            {
                worksheet.Cells[1, i + 1].Value = headers[i];
            }

            var row = 2;
            foreach (var item in kayitlar)
            {
                worksheet.Cells[row, 1].Value = ToPalestineLocal(item.OlusturulmaTarihi);
                worksheet.Cells[row, 2].Value = SafeSpreadsheetText(item.IpAdresi);
                worksheet.Cells[row, 3].Value = SafeSpreadsheetText(item.Ulke);
                worksheet.Cells[row, 4].Value = SafeSpreadsheetText(item.Sehir);
                worksheet.Cells[row, 5].Value = SafeSpreadsheetText(item.Metod);
                worksheet.Cells[row, 6].Value = SafeSpreadsheetText(item.Url);
                worksheet.Cells[row, 7].Value = SafeSpreadsheetText(
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.ReferansUrl) ? _localizer["Admin_DirectUnknown"].Value : item.ReferansUrl);
                worksheet.Cells[row, 8].Value = SafeSpreadsheetText(
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.KullaniciAdi) || item.KullaniciAdi == "Misafir"
                        ? _localizer["Admin_VisitorGuest"].Value
                        : item.KullaniciAdi);
                worksheet.Cells[row, 9].Value = SafeSpreadsheetText(
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.CihazModeli) ? _localizer["Admin_VisitorUnknown"].Value : item.CihazModeli);
                worksheet.Cells[row, 10].Value = SafeSpreadsheetText(item.Tarayici);
                worksheet.Cells[row, 11].Value = SafeSpreadsheetText(item.IsletimSistemi);
                row++;
            }

            using (var range = worksheet.Cells[1, 1, 1, headers.Length])
            {
                range.Style.Font.Bold = true;
                range.Style.Fill.PatternType = ExcelFillStyle.Solid;
                range.Style.Fill.BackgroundColor.SetColor(System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(49, 53, 17));
                range.Style.Font.Color.SetColor(System.Drawing.Color.White);
            }

            worksheet.Column(1).Style.Numberformat.Format = "yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss";
            if (worksheet.Dimension != null)
            {
                worksheet.Cells[worksheet.Dimension.Address].AutoFitColumns();
            }

            return File(
                package.GetAsByteArray(),
                "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
                $"visitor-traffic-{exportTime:yyyyMMdd-HHmm}.xlsx");
        }

        public Task<IActionResult> Indir(string? q, string? metod, string? cihaz, DateTime? baslangic, DateTime? bitis)
        {
            return Task.FromResult<IActionResult>(RedirectToAction(nameof(Export), new { q, metod, cihaz, baslangic, bitis }));
        }

        private static string SafeSpreadsheetText(string? value)
        {
            var text = value ?? string.Empty;
            return text.Length > 0 && "=+-@".Contains(text[0]) ? "'" + text : text;
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Temizle()
        {
            await _context.Database.ExecuteSqlRawAsync("TRUNCATE TABLE \"ZiyaretciLoglari\"");
            TempData["Basari"] = _localizer["Admin_TrafficHistoryCleared"].Value;
            return RedirectToAction(nameof(Index));
        }

        private IQueryable<ZiyaretciLog> BuildFilteredQuery(string? q, string? metod, string? cihaz, DateTime? baslangic, DateTime? bitis)
        {
            var query = _context.ZiyaretciLoglari.AsNoTracking().AsQueryable();
            var term = q?.Trim();

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(term))
            {
                var normalized = term.ToLower();
                query = query.Where(x =>
                    (x.IpAdresi ?? string.Empty).ToLower().Contains(normalized) ||
                    (x.Url ?? string.Empty).ToLower().Contains(normalized) ||
                    (x.ReferansUrl ?? string.Empty).ToLower().Contains(normalized) ||
                    (x.KullaniciAdi ?? string.Empty).ToLower().Contains(normalized) ||
                    (x.Sehir ?? string.Empty).ToLower().Contains(normalized) ||
                    (x.Ulke ?? string.Empty).ToLower().Contains(normalized) ||
                    (x.Tarayici ?? string.Empty).ToLower().Contains(normalized) ||
                    (x.IsletimSistemi ?? string.Empty).ToLower().Contains(normalized) ||
                    (x.CihazModeli ?? string.Empty).ToLower().Contains(normalized));
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(metod) && !string.Equals(metod, "Tumu", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                var methodValue = metod.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
                query = query.Where(x => x.Metod.ToUpper() == methodValue);
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cihaz) && !string.Equals(cihaz, "Tumu", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                var deviceValue = cihaz.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
                if (deviceValue == "mobil")
                {
                    query = query.Where(x =>
                        ((x.CihazModeli ?? string.Empty) + " " + (x.IsletimSistemi ?? string.Empty)).ToLower().Contains("iphone") ||
                        ((x.CihazModeli ?? string.Empty) + " " + (x.IsletimSistemi ?? string.Empty)).ToLower().Contains("android") ||
                        ((x.CihazModeli ?? string.Empty) + " " + (x.IsletimSistemi ?? string.Empty)).ToLower().Contains("mobile"));
                }
                else if (deviceValue == "masaustu")
                {
                    query = query.Where(x =>
                        !(((x.CihazModeli ?? string.Empty) + " " + (x.IsletimSistemi ?? string.Empty)).ToLower().Contains("iphone") ||
                          ((x.CihazModeli ?? string.Empty) + " " + (x.IsletimSistemi ?? string.Empty)).ToLower().Contains("android") ||
                          ((x.CihazModeli ?? string.Empty) + " " + (x.IsletimSistemi ?? string.Empty)).ToLower().Contains("mobile")));
                }
            }

            if (baslangic.HasValue)
            {
                var start = PalestineLocalDateToUtc(baslangic.Value.Date);
                query = query.Where(x => x.OlusturulmaTarihi >= start);
            }

            if (bitis.HasValue)
            {
                var end = PalestineLocalDateToUtc(bitis.Value.Date.AddDays(1));
                query = query.Where(x => x.OlusturulmaTarihi < end);
            }

            return query;
        }

        private static int NormalizePageSize(int pageSize)
        {
            return pageSize is 50 or 100 ? pageSize : 20;
        }

        private static bool IsMobile(ZiyaretciLog log)
        {
            var text = $"{log.CihazModeli} {log.IsletimSistemi}".ToLowerInvariant();
            return text.Contains("iphone") || text.Contains("android") || text.Contains("mobile");
        }

        private string NormalizeReferer(string? referer)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(referer))
            {
                return _localizer["Admin_DirectUnknown"].Value;
            }

            if (Uri.TryCreate(referer, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
            {
                return uri.Host.Replace("www.", string.Empty);
            }

            return referer.Length > 48 ? referer[..48] : referer;
        }

        private static DateTime PalestineLocalDateToUtc(DateTime value)
        {
            var localValue = DateTime.SpecifyKind(value, DateTimeKind.Unspecified);
            return TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeToUtc(localValue, PalestineTimeZone);
        }

        private static DateTime ToPalestineLocal(DateTime value)
        {
            var utcValue = value.Kind == DateTimeKind.Utc
                ? value
                : DateTime.SpecifyKind(value, DateTimeKind.Utc);

            return TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(utcValue, PalestineTimeZone);
        }

        private static TimeZoneInfo ResolvePalestineTimeZone()
        {
            foreach (var timeZoneId in new[] { "Asia/Gaza", "West Bank Standard Time" })
            {
                try
                {
                    return TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById(timeZoneId);
                }
                catch (TimeZoneNotFoundException)
                {
                }
                catch (InvalidTimeZoneException)
                {
                }
            }

            return TimeZoneInfo.Utc;
        }
    }
}

        public IReadOnlyList<RaporCouponMetric> KuponPerformansi { get; set; } = Array.Empty<RaporCouponMetric>();
        public IReadOnlyList<RaporTrafficMetric> TrafikKaynaklari { get; set; } = Array.Empty<RaporTrafficMetric>();
        public IReadOnlyList<RaporTrafficMetric> EnCokGezilenSayfalar { get; set; } = Array.Empty<RaporTrafficMetric>();
        public IReadOnlyList<RaporTrafficMetric> CihazDagilimi { get; set; } = Array.Empty<RaporTrafficMetric>();
        public IReadOnlyList<RaporKargoMetric> KargoPerformansi { get; set; } = Array.Empty<RaporKargoMetric>();
        public IReadOnlyList<RaporReturnReasonMetric> IadeIptalNedenleri { get; set; } = Array.Empty<RaporReturnReasonMetric>();
        public IReadOnlyList<RaporInsightItem> Oneriler { get; set; } = Array.Empty<RaporInsightItem>();
    }

@section Scripts {
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.ca-settings-tab');
            const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.ca-settings-panel');

            tabs.forEach(tab => {
                tab.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    tabs.forEach(item => item.classList.remove('active'));
                    panels.forEach(panel => panel.classList.remove('active'));
                    this.classList.add('active');
                    document.getElementById('panel-' + this.dataset.target)?.classList.add('active');
                });
            });

            const kargoSelect = document.getElementById('kargoFirmasiSelect');
            const takipInput = document.querySelector('[name="KargoTakipUrl"]');

            kargoSelect?.addEventListener('change', function () {
                const selectedOption = this.options[this.selectedIndex];
                const takipUrl = selectedOption?.dataset?.takipUrl;

                if (takipInput && takipUrl && !takipInput.value.trim()) {
                    takipInput.value = takipUrl;
                }
            });
        });
    </script>
}

@functions {
    string FormatIban(string iban)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(iban)) return "";
        var clean = iban.Replace(" ", "");
        var parts = new List<string>();
        for (int i = 0; i < clean.Length; i += 4)
            parts.Add(clean.Substring(i, Math.Min(4, clean.Length - i)));
        return string.Join(" ", parts);
    }
}

@section Scripts {
    <script>
        const emailCopiedMessage = @Json.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_EmailCopied"].Value);
        const emailCopyFailedMessage = @Json.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_EmailCopyFailed"].Value);
        const newsletterTitleFallback = @Json.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_NewsletterTitleFallback"].Value);
        const siteReviewFallback = @Json.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_ViewSite"].Value);

        document.querySelector('[data-select-all-subscribers]')?.addEventListener('change', function (event) {
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-subscriber-checkbox]').forEach(function (checkbox) {
                checkbox.checked = event.target.checked;
            });
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-copy-email]').forEach(function (button) {
            button.addEventListener('click', async function () {
                const email = button.getAttribute('data-copy-email');
                try {
                    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(email);
                    if (window.showAdminToast) {
                        window.showAdminToast(emailCopiedMessage, 'success');
                    } else if (window.showToast) {
                        window.showToast(emailCopiedMessage, 'success');
                    }
                } catch {
                    if (window.showAdminToast) {
                        window.showAdminToast(emailCopyFailedMessage, 'error');
                    } else if (window.showToast) {
                        window.showToast(emailCopyFailedMessage, 'error');
                    }
                }
            });
        });

        const subjectInput = document.getElementById('newsletterSubject');
        const contentInput = document.getElementById('newsletterContent');
        const buttonTextInput = document.getElementById('newsletterButtonText');
        const buttonLinkInput = document.getElementById('newsletterButtonLink');
        const previewSubject = document.getElementById('newsletterPreviewSubject');
        const previewContent = document.getElementById('newsletterPreviewContent');
        const previewButton = document.getElementById('newsletterPreviewButton');
        const newsletterForm = document.getElementById('newsletterMailForm');
        const selectedMailIds = document.getElementById('selectedMailIds');

        function updateNewsletterPreview() {
            if (previewSubject) {
                previewSubject.textContent = subjectInput?.value?.trim() || newsletterTitleFallback;
            }

            if (previewContent) {
                const lines = (contentInput?.value || '')
                    .split(/\r?\n/)
                    .map(x => x.trim())
                    .filter(Boolean);

                previewContent.innerHTML = '';
                lines.forEach(function (line) {
                    const paragraph = document.createElement('p');
                    paragraph.textContent = line;
                    previewContent.appendChild(paragraph);
                });
            }

            if (previewButton) {
                const buttonText = buttonTextInput?.value?.trim();
                const buttonLink = buttonLinkInput?.value?.trim();
                previewButton.textContent = buttonText || siteReviewFallback;
                previewButton.style.display = buttonLink ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
            }
        }

        [subjectInput, contentInput, buttonTextInput, buttonLinkInput].forEach(function (input) {
            input?.addEventListener('input', updateNewsletterPreview);
        });

        newsletterForm?.addEventListener('submit', function () {
            if (!selectedMailIds) return;
            selectedMailIds.innerHTML = '';
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-subscriber-checkbox]:checked').forEach(function (checkbox) {
                const hidden = document.createElement('input');
                hidden.type = 'hidden';
                hidden.name = 'mailAboneIds';
                hidden.value = checkbox.value;
                selectedMailIds.appendChild(hidden);
            });
        });

        updateNewsletterPreview();
    </script>
}

<script>
    const isDark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
    const gridColor = isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,.08)' : 'rgba(15,23,42,.08)';
    const textColor = isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b';

    const chartCanvas = document.getElementById('revenueChart');
    if (chartCanvas) {
        const chartLabels = @Html.Raw(chartLabelsJson);
        const chartData = @Html.Raw(chartDataJson);

        new Chart(chartCanvas, {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: chartLabels,
                datasets: [{
                    label: '@Localizer["Admin_RevenueCurrency"]',
                    data: chartData,
                    borderColor: '#ff6b35',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,107,53,.12)',
                    fill: true,
                    tension: .35,
                    borderWidth: 3,
                    pointRadius: 4,
                    pointHoverRadius: 6,
                    pointBackgroundColor: '#ff6b35',
                    pointBorderColor: '#fff',
                    pointBorderWidth: 2
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                plugins: {
                    legend: { display: false }
                },
                scales: {
                    x: {
                        grid: { color: gridColor },
                        ticks: { color: textColor }
                    },
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero: true,
                        grid: { color: gridColor },
                        ticks: {
                            color: textColor,
                            callback: function(value) { return value + ' ₪'; }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    // --- 12 Aylık Ciro Trendi ---
    const monthlyChart = document.getElementById('monthlyRevenueChart');
    if (monthlyChart) {
        const monthlyLabels = @Html.Raw(monthlyLabelsJson);
        const monthlyData = @Html.Raw(monthlyDataJson);
        new Chart(monthlyChart, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: {
                labels: monthlyLabels,
                datasets: [{
                    label: '@Localizer["Admin_RevenueCurrency"]',
                    data: monthlyData,
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(49,53,17,.72)',
                    borderRadius: 6,
                    borderWidth: 0
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                plugins: {
                    legend: { display: false }
                },
                scales: {
                    x: {
                        grid: { color: gridColor },
                        ticks: { color: textColor }
                    },
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero: true,
                        grid: { color: gridColor },
                        ticks: {
                            color: textColor,
                            callback: function(value) { return value + ' ₪'; }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    // --- Kategori Performansı (doughnut) ---
    const categoryChart = document.getElementById('categoryChart');
    if (categoryChart) {
        const catLabels = @Html.Raw(categoryLabelsJson);
        const catData = @Html.Raw(categoryRevenueJson);
        const catColors = ['#313511','#b8a35a','#ff6b35','#2563eb','#16a34a','#f59e0b'];
        new Chart(categoryChart, {
            type: 'doughnut',
            data: {
                labels: catLabels,
                datasets: [{
                    data: catData,
                    backgroundColor: catColors.slice(0, catLabels.length),
                    borderWidth: 0
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                plugins: {
                    legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { boxWidth: 12, padding: 8, font: { size: 10 } } }
                }
            }
        });
    }
</script>
}

@functions {
    private static string Para(decimal tutar) => tutar.ToString("N2") + " ₪";

    private static string GetProductImage(FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.SiparisDetay detay)
    {
        var image = detay.UrunSecenek?.GorselUrl
            ?? detay.Urun?.AnaGorselUrl
            ?? detay.Urun?.UrunResimleri?.FirstOrDefault(x => !x.SilindiMi)?.ResimYolu;

        return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(image) ? "/74anrps48logo2.svg" : image;
    }

    private static string GetVariantText(FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.SiparisDetay detay)
    {
        var secenek = detay.UrunSecenek?.VaryantOzeti;
        var cerceve = detay.CerceveModeli;

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secenek) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cerceve))
        {
            return $"{secenek} / {cerceve}";
        }

        return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secenek)
            ? secenek
            : (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cerceve) ? cerceve : "-");
    }

    private Microsoft.AspNetCore.Html.IHtmlContent IadeDurumBadge(int durum)
    {
        var html = durum switch
        {
            0 => $"<span class=\"ca-badge ca-badge-warning\"><i class=\"fas fa-clock\"></i> {Localizer["Pending"]}</span>",
            1 => $"<span class=\"ca-badge ca-badge-info\"><i class=\"fas fa-check\"></i> {Localizer["Approved"]}</span>",
            2 => $"<span class=\"ca-badge ca-badge-success\"><i class=\"fas fa-check-double\"></i> {Localizer["Completed"]}</span>",
            3 => $"<span class=\"ca-badge ca-badge-danger\"><i class=\"fas fa-times\"></i> {Localizer["Rejected"]}</span>",
            _ => $"<span class=\"ca-badge ca-badge-secondary\">{Localizer["Unknown"]}</span>"
        };

        return new Microsoft.AspNetCore.Html.HtmlString(html);
    }
}

    var unreadOnly = ViewBag.UnreadOnly is bool onlyUnread && onlyUnread;
    var unreadCount = ViewBag.UnreadCount is int totalUnread ? totalUnread : 0;
    var totalCount = ViewBag.TotalCount is int total ? total : 0;
    var readCount = ViewBag.ReadCount is int read ? read : 0;
    var todayCount = ViewBag.TodayCount is int today ? today : 0;
    var search = ViewBag.Search as string ?? string.Empty;

    static string Shorten(string? value, int max)
    {
        value = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? string.Empty : value.Trim();
        return value.Length <= max ? value : value[..max] + "...";
    }
}

@section Scripts {
    <script>
        (function () {
            const selectAll = document.getElementById('selectAllMessages');
            const checkboxes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ca-message-checkbox'));
             const bulkButton = document.getElementById('bulkReadButton');
             const markSelectedText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_MarkSelectedAsRead"].Value));
             const markCountText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_MarkNMessagesRead"].Value));

            function refreshBulkState() {
                const selected = checkboxes.filter(x => x.checked).length;
                if (bulkButton) {
                    bulkButton.disabled = selected === 0;
                    bulkButton.innerHTML = selected === 0
                        ? `<i class="fas fa-check-double"></i> ${markSelectedText}`
                        : `<i class="fas fa-check-double"></i> ${selected} ${markCountText}`;
                }

                if (selectAll) {
                    selectAll.checked = selected > 0 && selected === checkboxes.length;
                    selectAll.indeterminate = selected > 0 && selected < checkboxes.length;
                }
            }

            selectAll?.addEventListener('change', function () {
                checkboxes.forEach(x => x.checked = selectAll.checked);
                refreshBulkState();
            });

            checkboxes.forEach(x => x.addEventListener('change', refreshBulkState));
            refreshBulkState();
        })();
    </script>
}

                                <tr class="collapse" id="firma-@firma.Id">

                                            @Html.AntiForgeryToken()

                                                <div class="col-md-3">

                                                        <option value="true" selected="@firma.AktifMi">@Localizer["Admin_Aktif"]</option>

                                                <div class="col-md-5"><input name="GondericiAdres" value="@firma.GondericiAdres" class="ca-input" /></div>
                                                <div class="col-md-3"><input name="GondericiTelefon" value="@firma.GondericiTelefon" class="ca-input" /></div>
                                                <div class="col-md-3">
                                                    <select name="VarsayilanMi" class="ca-select">
                                                        <option value="false" selected="@(!firma.VarsayilanMi)">@Localizer["Admin_NotDefault"]</option>
                                                        <option value="true" selected="@firma.VarsayilanMi">@Localizer["Admin_Varsayilan"]</option>
                                                    </select>
                                                </div>
                                                <div class="col-md-9 text-end">

                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </form>
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            }
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

                        <select id="bolgeFiltreUlke" class="ca-select form-select-sm" style="width:auto; min-width:120px;">
                             <option value="">@Localizer["Admin_AllCountries"]</option>

            <button type="button" class="ca-btn ca-btn-secondary" id="bolgeFiyatYenileBtn">
                <i class="fas fa-rotate me-1"></i> @Localizer["Admin_Refresh"]
            </button>
        </div>
        <div class="ca-card-body">
            <div id="bolgeFiyatListesi" class="table-responsive">
                <div class="text-center py-5 text-muted">
                    <i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i> @Localizer["Admin_Loading"]
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

@section Scripts {
<script>
(function() {
    const deleteRegionText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_DeleteRegionConfirm"].Value));
    const deleteCityText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_DeleteCityConfirm"].Value));
    const noRegionText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_NoRegionYet"].Value));
    const noCityText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_NoCity"].Value));
    const cityCountText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_CityCount"].Value));
    const loadErrorText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_LoadError"].Value));
    const priceLoadErrorText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_PriceLoadError"].Value));
    const noCarrierProvinceText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_NoCarrierProvince"].Value));
    const editRegionText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_EditRegion"].Value));
    const provinceText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_Province"].Value));

    function getToken() {
        return document.querySelector('#bolgeForm input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]')?.value
            || document.querySelector('#sehirForm input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]')?.value;
    }

    function showToast(message, type) {
        if (typeof Swal !== 'undefined') {
            Swal.fire({ icon: type === 'success' ? 'success' : 'error', title: message, timer: 2500, showConfirmButton: false });
        } else {
            alert(message);
        }
    }

    function showPanelMessage(container, message, cssClass) {
        const node = document.createElement('div');
        node.className = cssClass;
        node.textContent = String(message || '');
        container.replaceChildren(node);
    }

    function setRegionFormTitle(iconClass, text) {
        const title = document.getElementById('bolgeFormTitle');
        const icon = document.createElement('i');
        icon.className = iconClass;
        title.replaceChildren(icon, document.createTextNode(String(text || '')));
    }

    function loadBolgeler() {
        fetch('/Admin/Kargo/BolgeListesi')
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(data => {
                renderBolgeler(data);
                populateBolgeSelect(data);
            })
             .catch(() => {
                 showPanelMessage(document.getElementById('bolgeListesi'), loadErrorText, 'col-12 text-center text-danger py-4');
             });

    }

    function loadBolgeFiyatlari() {
        fetch('/Admin/Kargo/BolgeFiyatListesi')
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(renderBolgeFiyatlari)
             .catch(() => {
                 showPanelMessage(document.getElementById('bolgeFiyatListesi'), priceLoadErrorText, 'text-center text-danger py-4');
             });

    }

    function renderBolgeFiyatlari(data) {
        const container = document.getElementById('bolgeFiyatListesi');
        const firmalar = data.firmalar || [];
        const bolgeler = data.bolgeler || [];
        const fiyatlar = data.fiyatlar || [];

        if (!firmalar.length || !bolgeler.length) {
            showPanelMessage(container, noCarrierProvinceText, 'text-center text-muted py-4');
            return;
        }

        const fiyatMap = new Map(fiyatlar.map(f => [f.kargoFirmasiId + '-' + f.bolgeId, f.fiyat]));
        const table = document.createElement('table');
        table.className = 'ca-table';
        const thead = document.createElement('thead');
        const headerRow = document.createElement('tr');
        const provinceHeader = document.createElement('th');
        provinceHeader.className = 'ps-4';
        provinceHeader.textContent = provinceText;
        headerRow.appendChild(provinceHeader);
        firmalar.forEach(firma => {
            const th = document.createElement('th');
            th.textContent = String(firma.ad || '');
            headerRow.appendChild(th);
        });
        thead.appendChild(headerRow);
        const tbody = document.createElement('tbody');

        bolgeler.forEach(bolge => {
            const row = document.createElement('tr');
            const regionCell = document.createElement('td');
            regionCell.className = 'ps-4 ca-fw-bold';
            regionCell.textContent = String(bolge.ad || '');
            row.appendChild(regionCell);
            firmalar.forEach(firma => {
                const value = fiyatMap.has(firma.id + '-' + bolge.id) ? fiyatMap.get(firma.id + '-' + bolge.id) : firma.fiyat;
                const cell = document.createElement('td');
                const group = document.createElement('div');
                group.className = 'input-group input-group-sm';
                group.style.minWidth = '130px';
                const input = document.createElement('input');
                input.className = 'form-control bolge-fiyat-input';
                input.type = 'number';
                input.min = '0';
                input.step = '0.01';
                input.value = Number(value || 0).toFixed(2);
                input.dataset.firmaId = String(firma.id);
                input.dataset.bolgeId = String(bolge.id);
                const currency = document.createElement('span');
                currency.className = 'input-group-text';
                currency.textContent = '₪';
                group.append(input, currency);
                cell.appendChild(group);
                row.appendChild(cell);
            });
            tbody.appendChild(row);
        });

        table.append(thead, tbody);
        container.replaceChildren(table);
    }

    function saveBolgeFiyat(input) {
        const fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('kargoFirmasiId', input.dataset.firmaId);
        fd.append('bolgeId', input.dataset.bolgeId);
        fd.append('fiyat', input.value || '0');
        fd.append('__RequestVerificationToken', getToken());

        fetch('/Admin/Kargo/BolgeFiyatKaydet', { method: 'POST', body: fd })
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(d => showToast(d.message, d.success ? 'success' : 'error'));
    }

    function renderBolgeler(bolgeler) {
        const container = document.getElementById('bolgeListesi');
        const ulkeFilter = document.getElementById('bolgeFiltreUlke')?.value || '';
        const filtered = ulkeFilter ? bolgeler.filter(b => b.ulke === ulkeFilter) : bolgeler;

        if (!filtered.length) {
            showPanelMessage(container, noRegionText, 'col-12 text-center text-muted py-4');
            return;
        }

        const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
        filtered.forEach(b => {
            const column = document.createElement('div');
            column.className = 'col-md-6';
            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'ca-card h-100';
            const header = document.createElement('div');
            header.className = 'ca-card-header py-2 px-3 d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center';
            const heading = document.createElement('div');
            const name = document.createElement('strong');
            name.textContent = String(b.ad || '');
            heading.appendChild(name);
            if (b.ulke) {
                const country = document.createElement('span');
                country.className = 'ca-badge ca-badge-info ms-1';
                country.textContent = String(b.ulke);
                heading.appendChild(country);
            }
            const description = document.createElement('div');
            description.className = 'small text-muted';
            description.textContent = String(b.aciklama || '');
            heading.appendChild(description);

            const actions = document.createElement('div');
            actions.className = 'd-flex gap-1';
            const edit = document.createElement('button');
            edit.type = 'button';
            edit.className = 'ca-btn-icon';
            edit.title = '@Localizer["Admin_Duzenle"]';
            edit.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('i'), { className: 'fas fa-pen' }));
            edit.addEventListener('click', () => window.bolgeApp.duzenleBolge(b.id, b.ad || '', b.ulke || '', b.aciklama || '', b.sira, b.fiyat));
            const remove = document.createElement('button');
            remove.type = 'button';
            remove.className = 'ca-btn-icon text-danger';
            remove.title = '@Localizer["Admin_Sil"]';
            remove.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('i'), { className: 'fas fa-trash' }));
            remove.addEventListener('click', () => window.bolgeApp.silBolge(b.id, b.ad || ''));
            actions.append(edit, remove);
            header.append(heading, actions);

            const body = document.createElement('div');
            body.className = 'ca-card-body py-2 px-3';
            const summary = document.createElement('div');
            summary.className = 'd-flex justify-content-between mb-2';
            const count = document.createElement('div');
            count.className = 'small text-muted';
            count.textContent = cityCountText.replace('{0}', b.sehirSayisi || 0);
            const price = document.createElement('div');
            price.className = 'ca-fw-bold small text-primary';
            price.textContent = Number(b.fiyat || 0).toFixed(2) + ' ₪';
            summary.append(count, price);
            const cityList = document.createElement('div');
            cityList.className = 'sehir-list d-flex flex-wrap gap-1';
            if (Array.isArray(b.sehirler) && b.sehirler.length) {
                b.sehirler.forEach(s => {
                    const badge = document.createElement('span');
                    badge.className = 'badge fs-6 fw-normal py-2 px-3 me-1 mb-1';
                    badge.style.cssText = 'background:#e8f5e9;color:#2e7d32;border:1px solid #a5d6a7;border-radius:20px;';
                    badge.appendChild(document.createTextNode(String(s.sehirAdi || '')));
                    const cityRemove = document.createElement('button');
                    cityRemove.type = 'button';
                    cityRemove.className = 'btn-close btn-close-sm ms-2';
                    cityRemove.style.fontSize = '0.6rem';
                    cityRemove.title = '@Localizer["Admin_Sil"]';
                    cityRemove.addEventListener('click', () => window.bolgeApp.silSehir(s.id, s.sehirAdi || ''));
                    badge.appendChild(cityRemove);
                    cityList.appendChild(badge);
                });
            } else {
                const empty = document.createElement('span');
                empty.className = 'text-muted small';
                empty.textContent = noCityText;
                cityList.appendChild(empty);
            }
            body.append(summary, cityList);
            card.append(header, body);
            column.appendChild(card);
            fragment.appendChild(column);
        });
        container.replaceChildren(fragment);
    }

    function populateBolgeSelect(bolgeler) {
        const select = document.getElementById('SehirBolgeId');
        if (!select) return;
        const currentVal = select.value;
        select.replaceChildren();
        const placeholder = document.createElement('option');
        placeholder.value = '';
        placeholder.textContent = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_SelectRegion"].Value));
        select.appendChild(placeholder);
        bolgeler.forEach(b => {
            const opt = document.createElement('option');
            opt.value = b.id;
            opt.textContent = (b.ulke ? b.ulke + ' - ' : '') + b.ad;
            select.appendChild(opt);
        });
        if (currentVal) select.value = currentVal;
    }

    window.bolgeApp = {
        duzenleBolge(id, ad, ulke, aciklama, sira, fiyat) {
            document.getElementById('BolgeId').value = id;
            document.getElementById('BolgeAd').value = ad;
            document.getElementById('BolgeUlke').value = ulke || '';
            document.getElementById('BolgeAciklama').value = aciklama || '';
            document.getElementById('BolgeSira').value = sira;
            document.getElementById('BolgeFiyat').value = Number(fiyat || 0).toFixed(2);
            setRegionFormTitle('fas fa-pen me-2', editRegionText);

            document.getElementById('bolgeIptalBtn').style.display = 'inline-block';
            document.getElementById('BolgeAd').focus();
        },
        silBolge(id, ad) {
            Swal.fire({
                 title: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_AreYouSure"].Value)),

                text: deleteRegionText.replace('{0}', ad),
                icon: 'warning',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonColor: '#d33',
                cancelButtonColor: '#6c757d',
                confirmButtonText: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_Yes"].Value)),
                cancelButtonText: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_Iptal"].Value))
            }).then(result => {
                if (!result.isConfirmed) return;
                const fd = new FormData();
                fd.append('id', id);
                fd.append('__RequestVerificationToken', getToken());
                fetch('/Admin/Kargo/BolgeSil', { method: 'POST', body: fd })
                    .then(r => r.json())
                    .then(d => {
                        showToast(d.message, d.success ? 'success' : 'error');
                        if (d.success) loadBolgeler();
                    });
            });
        },
        silSehir(id, ad) {
            Swal.fire({
                 title: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_DeleteCity"].Value)),

                text: deleteCityText.replace('{0}', ad),
                icon: 'warning',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonColor: '#d33',
                cancelButtonText: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_Iptal"].Value)),
                confirmButtonText: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_Delete"].Value))
            }).then(result => {
                if (!result.isConfirmed) return;
                const fd = new FormData();
                fd.append('id', id);
                fd.append('__RequestVerificationToken', getToken());
                fetch('/Admin/Kargo/SehirSil', { method: 'POST', body: fd })
                    .then(r => r.json())
                    .then(d => {
                        showToast(d.message, d.success ? 'success' : 'error');
                        if (d.success) loadBolgeler();
                    });
            });
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('bolgeForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const fd = new FormData(this);
        fd.append('__RequestVerificationToken', getToken());
        fetch('/Admin/Kargo/BolgeKaydet', { method: 'POST', body: fd })
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(d => {
                showToast(d.message, d.success ? 'success' : 'error');
                if (d.success) {
                    this.reset();
                    document.getElementById('BolgeId').value = '0';
                    setRegionFormTitle('fas fa-plus me-2', '@Localizer["Admin_NewRegion"]');
                    document.getElementById('bolgeIptalBtn').style.display = 'none';
                    loadBolgeler();
                }
            });
    });

    document.getElementById('bolgeIptalBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
        document.getElementById('bolgeForm').reset();
        document.getElementById('BolgeId').value = '0';
        setRegionFormTitle('fas fa-plus me-2', '@Localizer["Admin_NewRegion"]');
        this.style.display = 'none';
    });

    document.getElementById('sehirForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const fd = new FormData(this);
        fd.append('__RequestVerificationToken', getToken());
        fetch('/Admin/Kargo/SehirKaydet', { method: 'POST', body: fd })
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(d => {
                showToast(d.message, d.success ? 'success' : 'error');
                if (d.success) {
                    document.getElementById('SehirAdi').value = '';
                    loadBolgeler();
                }
            });
    });

    document.getElementById('bolgeFiltreUlke')?.addEventListener('change', function() {
        fetch('/Admin/Kargo/BolgeListesi')
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(data => renderBolgeler(data));
    });

    document.getElementById('bolgeFiyatYenileBtn')?.addEventListener('click', loadBolgeFiyatlari);
    document.getElementById('bolgeFiyatListesi')?.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
        if (e.target.classList.contains('bolge-fiyat-input')) {
            saveBolgeFiyat(e.target);
        }
    });

    loadBolgeler();
    loadBolgeFiyatlari();
})();
</script>
}

@model FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.Kategori
@inject IStringLocalizer<SharedResource> Localizer
@{
    Layout = "~/Areas/Admin/Views/Shared/_AdminLayout.cshtml";

<script>
    function updateCategoryPreview() {
        const input = document.getElementById('categoryImageUrl');
        const preview = document.getElementById('categoryPreview');
        if (!input || !preview) return;

        if (!input.value) {
             preview.innerHTML = '<div class="category-preview-placeholder"><i class="fas fa-folder-open"></i>@Localizer["Admin_NoImageDefined"]</div>';

            return;
        }

         preview.innerHTML = `<img src="${input.value}" alt="@Localizer["Admin_Kategori_Gorsel"]" onerror="this.closest('.category-preview').innerHTML='<div class=&quot;category-preview-placeholder&quot;><i class=&quot;fas fa-image&quot;></i>@Localizer["Admin_ImageLoadFailed"]</div>';">`;

    }

    function previewCategoryFile(event) {
        const file = event.target.files && event.target.files[0];
        const preview = document.getElementById('categoryPreview');
        if (!file || !preview) return;

        const imageUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        preview.innerHTML = `<img src="${imageUrl}" alt="@Localizer["Admin_Kategori_Gorsel"]">`;
        preview.querySelector('img').addEventListener('load', () => URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl), { once: true });
    }
</script>

<script>
    function updateCategoryPreview() {
        const input = document.getElementById('categoryImageUrl');
        const preview = document.getElementById('categoryPreview');
        if (!input || !preview) return;

        if (!input.value) {
             preview.innerHTML = '<div class="category-preview-placeholder"><i class="fas fa-folder-plus"></i>@Localizer["Admin_ImagePreview"]</div>';

            return;
        }

         preview.innerHTML = `<img src="${input.value}" alt="@Localizer["Admin_Kategori_Gorsel"]" onerror="this.closest('.category-preview').innerHTML='<div class=&quot;category-preview-placeholder&quot;><i class=&quot;fas fa-image&quot;></i>@Localizer["Admin_ImageLoadFailed"]</div>';">`;

    }

    function previewCategoryFile(event) {
        const file = event.target.files && event.target.files[0];
        const preview = document.getElementById('categoryPreview');
        if (!file || !preview) return;

        const imageUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        preview.innerHTML = `<img src="${imageUrl}" alt="@Localizer["Admin_Kategori_Gorsel"]">`;
        preview.querySelector('img').addEventListener('load', () => URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl), { once: true });
    }
</script>

========== FilistinProje.Web\Areas\Admin\Views\Kullanici\Duzenle.cshtml ==========
@model FilistinProje.Core.Models.KullaniciDuzenleViewModel
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = Localizer["Admin_EditUser"];
    Layout = "~/Areas/Admin/Views/Shared/_AdminLayout.cshtml";

    var lastLoginText = Model.LastAdminLoginUtc.HasValue
        ? ToPalestineTime(Model.LastAdminLoginUtc.Value).ToString("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm")
        : Localizer["Admin_NoAdminLoginYet"].Value;

    var previousLoginText = Model.PreviousAdminLoginUtc.HasValue
        ? ToPalestineTime(Model.PreviousAdminLoginUtc.Value).ToString("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm")
        : "-";

    var displayName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.AdSoyad) ? Localizer["Admin_UnnamedUser"].Value : Model.AdSoyad;
    var initial = displayName.Substring(0, 1).ToUpperInvariant();
}

@functions {
    private static DateTime ToPalestineTime(DateTime utc)
    {
        var utcValue = DateTime.SpecifyKind(utc, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        foreach (var id in new[] { "Asia/Hebron", "West Bank Standard Time" })
        {
            try
            {
                return TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(utcValue, TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById(id));
            }
            catch (TimeZoneNotFoundException) { }
            catch (InvalidTimeZoneException) { }
        }
        return utcValue.AddHours(3);
    }
}

    <script>
        document.querySelectorAll('.ca-role-option input[type="radio"]').forEach(function (radio) {
            radio.addEventListener('change', function () {
                document.querySelectorAll('.ca-role-option').forEach(function (item) {
                    item.classList.remove('is-selected');
                });

                if (radio.checked) {
                    radio.closest('.ca-role-option')?.classList.add('is-selected');
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

@functions {
    private static DateTime ToPalestineTime(DateTime utc)
    {
        var utcValue = DateTime.SpecifyKind(utc, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        foreach (var id in new[] { "Asia/Hebron", "West Bank Standard Time" })
        {
            try
            {
                return TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(utcValue, TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById(id));
            }
            catch (TimeZoneNotFoundException) { }
            catch (InvalidTimeZoneException) { }
        }
        return utcValue.AddHours(3);
    }

    private static string FormatDate(DateTime? value)
    {
        return value.HasValue ? ToPalestineTime(value.Value).ToString("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm") : "-";
    }

    private string PageUrl(int page, int? pageSize = null)
    {
        var query = new List<string>
        {
            $"page={page}",
            $"pageSize={pageSize ?? Model.PageSize}"
        };

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.Search))
        {
            query.Add($"search={Uri.EscapeDataString(Model.Search)}");
        }

        return $"/Admin/Kullanici?{string.Join("&", query)}";
    }
}

@section Scripts {
    <script>
        const passwordInput = document.getElementById('yeniSifre');
        const repeatInput = document.getElementById('sifreTekrar');
        const meter = document.getElementById('passwordMeter');
        const passwordHint = document.getElementById('passwordHint');
        const matchHint = document.getElementById('matchHint');
        const passwordTexts = {
            weak: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_PasswordStrengthWeak"].Value)),
            medium: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_PasswordStrengthMedium"].Value)),
            strong: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_PasswordStrengthStrong"].Value)),
            mustMatch: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_PasswordsMustMatch"].Value)),
            matching: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_PasswordsMatching"].Value)),
            notMatching: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_PasswordsNotMatching"].Value)),
            submitMismatch: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_PasswordSubmitMismatch"].Value))
        };

        function setRule(name, isOk) {
            const item = document.querySelector(`[data-rule="${name}"]`);
            if (item) {
                item.classList.toggle('is-ok', isOk);
            }
        }

        function updatePasswordState() {
            const value = passwordInput.value || '';
            const repeat = repeatInput.value || '';
            const checks = {
                length: value.length >= 6,
                upper: /[A-ZÇĞİÖŞÜ]/.test(value),
                lower: /[a-zçğıöşü]/.test(value),
                number: /\d/.test(value),
                symbol: /[^A-Za-z0-9ÇĞİÖŞÜçğıöşü]/.test(value),
                match: value.length > 0 && value === repeat
            };

            Object.keys(checks).forEach((key) => setRule(key, checks[key]));

            const score = ['length', 'upper', 'lower', 'number', 'symbol'].filter((key) => checks[key]).length;
            const percent = Math.max(8, score * 20);
            meter.style.width = `${percent}%`;
            meter.style.background = score <= 2 ? '#ef4444' : score <= 4 ? '#f59e0b' : '#16a34a';
            passwordHint.textContent = score <= 2
                ? passwordTexts.weak
                : score <= 4
                    ? passwordTexts.medium
                    : passwordTexts.strong;

            if (!repeat) {
                matchHint.textContent = passwordTexts.mustMatch;
                matchHint.classList.remove('text-success');
                matchHint.classList.remove('text-danger');
            } else if (checks.match) {
                matchHint.textContent = passwordTexts.matching;
                matchHint.classList.add('text-success');
                matchHint.classList.remove('text-danger');
            } else {
                matchHint.textContent = passwordTexts.notMatching;
                matchHint.classList.add('text-danger');
                matchHint.classList.remove('text-success');
            }
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle-password]').forEach((button) => {
            button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const input = document.getElementById(button.dataset.togglePassword);
                const icon = button.querySelector('i');
                const shouldShow = input.type === 'password';
                input.type = shouldShow ? 'text' : 'password';
                icon.classList.toggle('fa-eye', !shouldShow);
                icon.classList.toggle('fa-eye-slash', shouldShow);
            });
        });

        passwordInput.addEventListener('input', updatePasswordState);
        repeatInput.addEventListener('input', updatePasswordState);

        document.getElementById('passwordForm').addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
            if (passwordInput.value !== repeatInput.value) {
                event.preventDefault();
                repeatInput.focus();
                matchHint.textContent = passwordTexts.submitMismatch;
                matchHint.classList.add('text-danger');
            }
        });

        updatePasswordState();
    </script>
}

@section Scripts {
    <partial name="_ValidationScriptsPartial" />
    <script>
        (function () {
            const code = document.getElementById('Kod');
            const type = document.getElementById('Tip');
            const value = document.getElementById('Deger');
            const min = document.getElementById('MinSepetTutari');
            const previewCode = document.getElementById('previewCode');
            const previewDiscount = document.getElementById('previewDiscount');
            const previewMin = document.getElementById('previewMin');
            const couponCodeFallback = @Json.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_CouponCodeFallback"].Value);
            const discountText = @Json.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_DiscountText"].Value);
            const minCartText = @Json.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_MinCartPreviewJs"].Value);
            const usableWithoutMinimumText = @Json.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_UsableWithoutMinimum"].Value);

            function money(input) {
                const n = Number(String(input || '0').replace(',', '.'));
                return window.formatMoney(n);
            }

            function refreshPreview() {
                const normalizedCode = (code.value || couponCodeFallback).toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
                code.value = normalizedCode === couponCodeFallback.toUpperCase() ? code.value.toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, '') : normalizedCode;
                previewCode.textContent = normalizedCode;

                if (type.value === '1') {
                    previewDiscount.textContent = `${money(value.value)} ₪ ${discountText}`;
                } else {
                    previewDiscount.textContent = `%${window.formatMoney(Number(value.value || 0))} ${discountText}`;
                }

                const minValue = Number(String(min.value || '0').replace(',', '.'));
                previewMin.textContent = minValue > 0
                    ? `${money(min.value)} ${minCartText}`
                    : usableWithoutMinimumText;
            }

            [code, type, value, min].forEach(el => el && el.addEventListener('input', refreshPreview));
            refreshPreview();
        })();
    </script>
}


========== FilistinProje.Web\Areas\Admin\Views\Kupon\Index.cshtml ==========
@model IEnumerable<FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.Kupon>
@{
    Layout = "~/Areas/Admin/Views/Shared/_AdminLayout.cshtml";
    ViewData["Title"] = Localizer["Admin_CouponManagement"];
    var kuponlar = Model.ToList();
    var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

    string DiscountText(FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.Kupon kupon)
        => kupon.Tip == 0 ? $"%{kupon.Deger:N0}" : $"{kupon.Deger:N2} ₪";

    string StatusClass(FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.Kupon kupon)
    {
        if (!kupon.AktifMi) return "ca-badge-secondary";
        if (kupon.SonKullanmaTarihi <= now) return "ca-badge-danger";
        if (kupon.KullanimLimiti > 0 && kupon.KullanilanMiktar >= kupon.KullanimLimiti) return "ca-badge-warning";
        return "ca-badge-success";
    }

    string StatusText(FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.Kupon kupon)
    {
        if (!kupon.AktifMi) return Localizer["Admin_Pasif"].Value;
        if (kupon.SonKullanmaTarihi <= now) return Localizer["Admin_Expired"].Value;
        if (kupon.KullanimLimiti > 0 && kupon.KullanilanMiktar >= kupon.KullanimLimiti) return Localizer["Admin_LimitReached"].Value;
        return Localizer["Admin_Aktif"].Value;
    }
}

@functions {
    private static DateTime ToPalestineTime(DateTime utc)
    {
        var utcValue = DateTime.SpecifyKind(utc, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        foreach (var id in new[] { "Asia/Hebron", "West Bank Standard Time" })
        {
            try
            {
                return TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(utcValue, TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById(id));
            }
            catch (TimeZoneNotFoundException) { }
            catch (InvalidTimeZoneException) { }
        }
        return utcValue.AddHours(3);
    }

    private string FormatGiris(DateTime? utc)
    {
        if (!utc.HasValue) return "-";
        var local = ToPalestineTime(utc.Value);
        var now = ToPalestineTime(DateTime.UtcNow);
        if (local.Date == now.Date) return Localizer["Admin_TodayAt", local.ToString("HH:mm")];
        if (local.Date == now.Date.AddDays(-1)) return Localizer["Admin_YesterdayAt", local.ToString("HH:mm")];
        return local.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm");
    }

    private static string SonGirisRengi(DateTime? utc)
    {
        if (!utc.HasValue) return "ca-text-muted";
        var fark = (DateTime.UtcNow - utc.Value).TotalHours;
        if (fark < 1) return "text-success";
        if (fark < 24) return "text-primary";
        if (fark < 168) return "ca-text-muted";
        return "ca-text-muted";
    }

    private static string RoleBadgeClass(string roleName)
    {
        return roleName switch
        {
            "SuperAdmin" or "Admin" => "ca-badge-danger",
            "Yonetici" => "ca-badge-warning",
            "SiparisYoneticisi" => "ca-badge-primary",
            "UrunYoneticisi" => "ca-badge-success",
            "IcerikYoneticisi" => "ca-badge-info",
            "KargoYoneticisi" => "ca-badge-neutral",
            "Goruntuleyici" => "ca-badge-dark",
            _ => "ca-badge-neutral"
        };
    }
}

@model FilistinProje.Core.Models.RaporIndexViewModel
@using System.Text.Json
@{
    Layout = "~/Areas/Admin/Views/Shared/_AdminLayout.cshtml";
    ViewData["Title"] = Localizer["Admin_Raporlar"];

    var revenueLabels = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model.GunlukMetrikler.Select(x => x.Tarih.ToString("dd.MM")));
    var revenueData = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model.GunlukMetrikler.Select(x => x.Ciro));
    var orderData = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model.GunlukMetrikler.Select(x => x.Siparis));
    var visitData = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model.GunlukMetrikler.Select(x => x.Ziyaret));
    var hourlyLabels = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model.SaatlikMetrikler.Select(x => $"{x.Saat:00}:00"));
    var hourlyOrders = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model.SaatlikMetrikler.Select(x => x.Siparis));
    var hourlyVisits = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model.SaatlikMetrikler.Select(x => x.Ziyaret));
    var categoryLabels = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model.KategoriPerformansi.Select(x => x.KategoriAdi));
    var categoryData = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model.KategoriPerformansi.Select(x => x.Ciro));
    var statusLabels = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model.DurumDagilimi.Select(x => x.Etiket));
    var statusData = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model.DurumDagilimi.Select(x => x.Adet));
    var revenueChartLabel = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_Revenue"].Value);
    var orderChartLabel = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_Order"].Value);
    var visitChartLabel = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_ReportVisits"].Value);

    string Money(decimal value) => value.ToString("N2") + " ₪";
    string Change(decimal current, decimal previous)
    {
        if (previous == 0 && current > 0) return "+%100";
        if (previous == 0) return "%0";
        var rate = (current - previous) * 100 / previous;
        return (rate >= 0 ? "+" : "") + "%" + rate.ToString("N1");
    }

    string CountChange(int current, int previous)
    {
        if (previous == 0 && current > 0) return "+%100";
        if (previous == 0) return "%0";
        var rate = (current - previous) * 100m / previous;
        return (rate >= 0 ? "+" : "") + "%" + rate.ToString("N1");
    }
}

========== FilistinProje.Web\Areas\Admin\Views\Siparis\Detay.cshtml ==========
@using FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar
@model FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.Siparis
@{
    Layout = "~/Areas/Admin/Views/Shared/_AdminLayout.cshtml";
    ViewData["Title"] = Localizer["Admin_OrderTitle", Model.Id];

    var urunler = ViewBag.UrunBilgileri as List<dynamic> ?? new List<dynamic>();
    var kargoFirmalari = ViewBag.KargoFirmalari as List<KargoFirmasi> ?? new List<KargoFirmasi>();
    var seciliKargo = ViewBag.SeciliKargoFirmasi as KargoFirmasi ?? kargoFirmalari.FirstOrDefault();
    var siteSettings = ViewBag.SiteSettings as FilistinProje.Core.Models.SiteAyarlari;
    var siparisNo = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.SiparisNo) ? $"#{Model.Id}" : Model.SiparisNo;
    var currentStep = SiparisDurumHelper.GetProgressStep(Model.Durum);
    var statusText = SiparisDurumHelper.GetLabel(Model.Durum);
    var toplamAdet = urunler.Sum(x => (int)x.Adet);
    var logoUrl = siteSettings?.SiteLogoUrl ?? "/74anrps48logo2.svg";
    var operasyonDurumlari = new[]
    {
        SiparisDurumHelper.SiparisAlindi,
        SiparisDurumHelper.UretimHazirlaniyor,
        SiparisDurumHelper.Paketleniyor,
        SiparisDurumHelper.KargoyaVerildi,
        SiparisDurumHelper.TeslimEdildi
    };
    var mevcutAdim = SiparisDurumHelper.GetProgressStep(Model.Durum);
    var secilebilirDurumlar = operasyonDurumlari
        .Where(x => x == Model.Durum || (mevcutAdim > 0 && SiparisDurumHelper.GetProgressStep(x) > mevcutAdim))
        .ToList();
    if (Model.Durum != SiparisDurumHelper.KargoyaVerildi &&
        Model.Durum != SiparisDurumHelper.TeslimEdildi &&
        Model.Durum != SiparisDurumHelper.IptalEdildi)
    {
        secilebilirDurumlar.Add(SiparisDurumHelper.IptalEdildi);
    }
    if (!secilebilirDurumlar.Contains(Model.Durum))
    {
        secilebilirDurumlar.Insert(0, Model.Durum);
    }
}

<script>
    function printShippingLabel() {
        const label = document.getElementById('printableLabel');
        if (!label) {
            return;
        }

        const printWindow = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=520,height=760');
        if (!printWindow) {
            return;
        }

        printWindow.document.open();
        printWindow.document.write(`<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>@Localizer["Admin_ShippingLabel"]</title>
    <style>
        @@page { size: 100mm 150mm; margin: 0; }
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }
        html, body {
            width: 100mm;
            height: 150mm;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: #fff;
            color: #111;
            font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
        }
        .ca-shipping-label {
            display: block !important;
            width: 100mm !important;
            height: 150mm !important;
            max-height: 150mm !important;
            overflow: hidden !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 5mm !important;
            border: 0 !important;
            background: #fff;
            color: #111;
            page-break-after: avoid;
            break-after: avoid;
        }
        .label-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid #111; padding-bottom: 8px; }
        .label-logo { max-width: 120px; max-height: 46px; object-fit: contain; }
        .label-title { margin: 12px 0 4px; font-size: 20px; }
        .label-meta { font-size: 12px; }
        .ca-label-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; }
        .ca-label-box { border: 1px solid #111; padding: 8px; min-height: 52px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; }
        .recipient-name { margin: 6px 0; font-size: 18px; }
        .product-table { width: 100%; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 12px; border-collapse: collapse; }
        .product-table td { border-top: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 4px 0; vertical-align: top; }
        .product-table tr:nth-child(n+7) { display: none; }
        .barcode { margin-top: 16px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid #111; padding: 10px; font-family: "Courier New", monospace; font-size: 26px; letter-spacing: 2px; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>${label.outerHTML}</body>
</html>`);
        printWindow.document.close();
        printWindow.focus();
        setTimeout(() => {
            printWindow.print();
            printWindow.close();
        }, 250);
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('button[onclick="window.print()"]').forEach((button) => {
        button.removeAttribute('onclick');
        button.addEventListener('click', printShippingLabel);
    });
</script>

@functions {
    private static TimeZoneInfo GetPalestineTimeZone()
    {
        foreach (var timeZoneId in new[] { "Asia/Gaza", "West Bank Standard Time", "UTC" })
        {
            try
            {
                return TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById(timeZoneId);
            }
            catch (TimeZoneNotFoundException) { }
            catch (InvalidTimeZoneException) { }
        }

        return TimeZoneInfo.Utc;
    }

    private static string FormatPalestineDateTime(DateTime value)
    {
        var utcValue = value.Kind == DateTimeKind.Utc
            ? value
            : DateTime.SpecifyKind(value, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        return TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(utcValue, GetPalestineTimeZone()).ToString("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm");
    }
}
@{
    Layout = "~/Areas/Admin/Views/Shared/_AdminLayout.cshtml";
    ViewData["Title"] = Localizer["Admin_OrderManagement"];

    int? currentDurum = ViewBag.CurrentDurum as int?;
    int? currentReceteDurum = ViewBag.CurrentReceteDurum as int?;
    var currentSearch = ViewBag.CurrentSearch as string ?? string.Empty;
    var detayOzetleri = ViewBag.SiparisDetayOzetleri as Dictionary<int, string> ?? new Dictionary<int, string>();
    var currentPage = ViewBag.Page as int? ?? 1;
    var pageSize = ViewBag.PageSize as int? ?? 20;
    var totalPages = ViewBag.TotalPages as int? ?? 1;
    var totalCount = ViewBag.TotalCount as int? ?? Model.Count();
    var pageSizeOptions = ViewBag.PageSizeOptions as int[] ?? new[] { 20, 50, 100 };

    string BuildUrl(int? pageValue = null, int? pageSizeValue = null)
    {
        var query = new List<string>();
        if (currentDurum.HasValue) query.Add($"durum={currentDurum.Value}");
        if (currentReceteDurum.HasValue) query.Add($"receteDurum={currentReceteDurum.Value}");
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(currentSearch)) query.Add($"search={Uri.EscapeDataString(currentSearch)}");
        query.Add($"page={pageValue ?? currentPage}");
        query.Add($"pageSize={pageSizeValue ?? pageSize}");
        return "/Admin/Siparis?" + string.Join("&", query);
    }
}
