<script>
    const selectAtLeastOneOrderText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_SelectAtLeastOneOrder"].Value));
    const bulkShippedConfirmText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_BulkShippedConfirm"].Value));
    const bulkPackingConfirmText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_BulkPackingConfirm"].Value));
    const bulkCancelConfirmText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_BulkCancelConfirm"].Value));
    const selectedOrderCountText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_SelectedOrderCount"].Value));
    const noSelectedOrderText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_NoSelectedOrder"].Value));
    const bulkDeliveredConfirmText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_BulkDeliveredConfirm"].Value));
    // Toplu işlem fonksiyonları
    function getSelectedOrders() {
        var checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.order-select:checked');
        var ids = [];
        checkboxes.forEach(function(cb) {
            ids.push(cb.value);
        });
        return ids;
    }

    function topluKargo() {
        var ids = getSelectedOrders();
        if (ids.length === 0) {
            alert(selectAtLeastOneOrderText);
            return;
        }
        if (!confirm(bulkShippedConfirmText.replace('{0}', ids.length))) return;
        
        // Create hidden inputs for the form
        var form = document.createElement('form');
        form.method = 'post';
        form.action = '/Admin/Siparis/TopluKargoyaVer';
        
        var token = document.createElement('input');
        token.type = 'hidden';
        token.name = '__RequestVerificationToken';
        token.value = document.querySelector('input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]').value;
        form.appendChild(token);
        
        ids.forEach(function(id) {
            var input = document.createElement('input');
            input.type = 'hidden';
            input.name = 'siparisIds';
            input.value = id;
            form.appendChild(input);
        });
        
        var kargoFirma = document.createElement('input');
        kargoFirma.type = 'hidden';
        kargoFirma.name = 'kargoFirmasiId';
        kargoFirma.value = '';
        form.appendChild(kargoFirma);
        
        var kargoNo = document.createElement('input');
        kargoNo.type = 'hidden';
        kargoNo.name = 'kargoNo';
        kargoNo.value = '';
        form.appendChild(kargoNo);
        
        document.body.appendChild(form);
        form.submit();
    }

    function topluPaket() {
        var ids = getSelectedOrders();
        if (ids.length === 0) {
            alert(selectAtLeastOneOrderText);
            return;
        }
        if (!confirm(bulkPackingConfirmText.replace('{0}', ids.length))) return;
        
        var form = document.createElement('form');
        form.method = 'post';
        form.action = '/Admin/Siparis/TopluDurumGuncelle';
        
        var token = document.createElement('input');
        token.type = 'hidden';
        token.name = '__RequestVerificationToken';
        token.value = document.querySelector('input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]').value;
        form.appendChild(token);
        
        ids.forEach(function(id) {
            var input = document.createElement('input');
            input.type = 'hidden';
            input.name = 'siparisIds';
            input.value = id;
            form.appendChild(input);
        });
        
        var durum = document.createElement('input');
        durum.type = 'hidden';
        durum.name = 'yeniDurum';
        durum.value = '8'; // Paketleniyor
        form.appendChild(durum);
        
        document.body.appendChild(form);
        form.submit();
    }

    function topluTeslimEt() {
        var ids = getSelectedOrders();
        if (ids.length === 0) {
            alert(selectAtLeastOneOrderText);
            return;
        }
        if (!confirm(bulkDeliveredConfirmText.replace('{0}', ids.length))) return;

        var container = document.getElementById('bulkDeliverInputs');
        container.innerHTML = '';

        ids.forEach(function(id) {
            var input = document.createElement('input');
            input.type = 'hidden';
            input.name = 'siparisIds';
            input.value = id;
            container.appendChild(input);
        });

        document.getElementById('bulkDeliverForm').submit();
    }

    function topluIptal() {
        var ids = getSelectedOrders();
        if (ids.length === 0) {
            alert(selectAtLeastOneOrderText);
            return;
        }
        if (!confirm(bulkCancelConfirmText.replace('{0}', ids.length))) return;
        
        document.getElementById('iptalSiparisIds').value = ids.join(',');
        document.getElementById('bulkIptalForm').submit();
    }

    // Toast notification
    function showToast(message, type) {
        var container = document.querySelector('.ca-toast-container');
        if (!container) {
            container = document.createElement('div');
            container.className = 'ca-toast-container';
            document.body.appendChild(container);
        }
        var toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.className = 'ca-toast ' + (type || 'info');
        var text = document.createElement('span');
        text.textContent = String(message ?? '');
        toast.appendChild(text);
        container.appendChild(toast);
        setTimeout(function() { toast.remove(); }, 3000);
    }

    // Check for toast param on load
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        var urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        var toastMsg = urlParams.get('toast');
        if (toastMsg) {
            showToast(decodeURIComponent(toastMsg), urlParams.get('toastType') || 'success');
            window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
        }
        
        // Checkbox change handler
        document.querySelectorAll('.order-select').forEach(function(cb) {
            cb.addEventListener('change', updateSelectedCount);
        });
        
        // Select all handler
        var selectAll = document.getElementById('selectAllOrders');
        if (selectAll) {
            selectAll.addEventListener('change', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.order-select').forEach(function(cb) {
                    cb.checked = selectAll.checked;
                });
                updateSelectedCount();
            });
        }
    });

    function updateSelectedCount() {
        var checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.order-select:checked');
        var count = checkboxes.length;
        document.getElementById('selectedOrderCount').textContent = count > 0 ? selectedOrderCountText.replace('{0}', count) : noSelectedOrderText;

        // Etiket basılabilecek durumlar: 0 (@Localizer["Admin_OrderReceived"]), 1 (@Localizer["Admin_Preparing"]), 8 (Paketleniyor)
        var validLabelStatuses = [0, 1, 8];
        var validLabelCount = 0;

        var labelContainer = document.getElementById('bulkLabelInputs');
        if (labelContainer) {
            labelContainer.innerHTML = '';
            checkboxes.forEach(function(cb) {
                var status = parseInt(cb.getAttribute('data-status'));
                if (validLabelStatuses.includes(status)) {
                    validLabelCount++;
                    var input = document.createElement('input');
                    input.type = 'hidden';
                    input.name = 'siparisIds';
                    input.value = cb.value;
                    labelContainer.appendChild(input);
                }
            });
        }

        var bulkLabelBtn = document.getElementById('bulkLabelButton');
        if (bulkLabelBtn) {
            bulkLabelBtn.disabled = (validLabelCount === 0);
        }

        var bulkConfirmBtn = document.getElementById('bulkConfirmButton');
        if (bulkConfirmBtn) {
            bulkConfirmBtn.disabled = (count === 0);
        }

        // Populate bulkConfirmInputs
        var confirmContainer = document.getElementById('bulkConfirmInputs');
        if (confirmContainer) {
            confirmContainer.innerHTML = '';
            checkboxes.forEach(function(cb) {
                var input = document.createElement('input');
                input.type = 'hidden';
                input.name = 'siparisIds';
                input.value = cb.value;
                confirmContainer.appendChild(input);
            });
        }
    }
</script>

@{
    Layout = null;
    var kargoFirmalari = ViewBag.KargoFirmalari as List<KargoFirmasi> ?? new List<KargoFirmasi>();
    var varsayilanKargo = kargoFirmalari.FirstOrDefault(x => x.VarsayilanMi) ?? kargoFirmalari.FirstOrDefault();
    var siteSettings = ViewBag.SiteSettings as FilistinProje.Core.Models.SiteAyarlari;
    var logoUrl = siteSettings?.SiteLogoUrl ?? "/74anrps48logo2.svg";
    var requestCulture = Context.Features.Get<IRequestCultureFeature>()?.RequestCulture.Culture;
    var htmlLang = requestCulture?.Name ?? "tr";
    var htmlDir = requestCulture?.TextInfo.IsRightToLeft == true ? "rtl" : "ltr";

    KargoFirmasi? FirmaBul(Siparis siparis)
    {
        if (siparis.KargoFirmasiId.HasValue)
        {
            var secili = kargoFirmalari.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == siparis.KargoFirmasiId.Value);
            if (secili != null)
            {
                return secili;
            }
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(siparis.KargoFirmasi))
        {
            var adIleBulunan = kargoFirmalari.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Ad.Equals(siparis.KargoFirmasi, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            if (adIleBulunan != null)
            {
                return adIleBulunan;
            }
        }

        return varsayilanKargo;
    }
}

@section Scripts {
<script>
function toggleMediaFields() {
    var tur = document.getElementById('turSelect').value;
    document.getElementById('resimYukleme').classList.toggle('d-none', tur === 'Video');
    document.getElementById('videoYukleme').classList.toggle('d-none', tur === 'Resim');
}

function previewResim(input) {
    var preview = document.getElementById('resimPreviewImg');
    var container = document.getElementById('resimOnizleme');
    if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
        var reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(e) {
            preview.src = e.target.result;
            container.classList.remove('d-none');
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(input.files[0]);
    }
}

function previewVideo(input) {
    var preview = document.getElementById('videoPreviewTag');
    var container = document.getElementById('videoOnizleme');
    if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
        var reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(e) {
            preview.src = e.target.result;
            container.classList.remove('d-none');
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(input.files[0]);
    }
}
</script>
}

function toggleMediaFields() {
    var tur = document.getElementById('turSelect').value;
    document.getElementById('resimYukleme').classList.toggle('d-none', tur === 'Video');
    document.getElementById('videoYukleme').classList.toggle('d-none', tur === 'Resim');
}

function previewResim(input) {
    var preview = document.getElementById('resimPreviewImg');
    var container = document.getElementById('resimOnizleme');
    if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
        var reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(e) {
            preview.src = e.target.result;
            container.classList.remove('d-none');
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(input.files[0]);
    }
}

function previewVideo(input) {
    var preview = document.getElementById('videoPreviewTag');
    var container = document.getElementById('videoOnizleme');
    if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
        var reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(e) {
            preview.src = e.target.result;
            container.classList.remove('d-none');
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(input.files[0]);
    }
}

document.querySelectorAll('input[name="Baslik"], input[name="ResimUrl"]').forEach(function(input) {
    input.addEventListener('input', updatePreview);
});

function updatePreview() {
    var baslik = document.querySelector('input[name="Baslik"]')?.value || '';
    var url = document.querySelector('input[name="ResimUrl"]')?.value || '';
    if (url) {
        var preview = document.querySelector('#livePreview img');
        if (preview) preview.src = url;
    }
}
</script>
}

@section Scripts {
<script>
(function() {
    const slideDeletedMessage = @Json.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_SlideDeleted"].Value);
    const deleteFailedMessage = @Json.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_DeleteFailed"].Value);
    const errorMessage = @Json.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_ErrorOccurred"].Value);
    const orderSavedMessage = @Json.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_OrderSaved"].Value);
    const orderSaveFailedMessage = @Json.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_OrderSaveFailed"].Value);
    let silId = null;
    var modalEl = document.getElementById('silModal');
    if (modalEl) { document.body.appendChild(modalEl); }
    var silModal = new bootstrap.Modal(modalEl);

    document.querySelectorAll('.btn-sil').forEach(function(btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            silId = this.getAttribute('data-id');
            silModal.show();
        });
    });

    document.getElementById('btnSilOnay').addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (!silId) return;
        fetch('@Url.Action("Sil", "Slayt")/' + silId, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'RequestVerificationToken': document.querySelector('input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]')?.value || ''
            }
        })
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(data => {
            silModal.hide();
            if (data.success) {
                document.querySelector('tr[data-id="' + silId + '"]')?.remove();
                showToast(slideDeletedMessage, 'success');
            } else {
                showToast(data.message || deleteFailedMessage, 'error');
            }
        })
        .catch(() => {
            silModal.hide();
            showToast(errorMessage, 'error');
        });
    });

    function showToast(message, type) {
        var container = document.querySelector('.toast-container') || (function() {
            var c = document.createElement('div');
            c.className = 'toast-container position-fixed bottom-0 end-0 p-3';
            document.body.appendChild(c);
            return c;
        })();
        var toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.className = 'toast align-items-center text-white bg-' + (type === 'success' ? 'success' : 'danger') + ' border-0';
        toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
        var row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'd-flex';
        var body = document.createElement('div');
        body.className = 'toast-body';
        body.textContent = String(message ?? '');
        var close = document.createElement('button');
        close.type = 'button';
        close.className = 'btn-close btn-close-white me-2 m-auto';
        close.setAttribute('data-bs-dismiss', 'toast');
        row.append(body, close);
        toast.appendChild(row);
        container.appendChild(toast);
        var bs = new bootstrap.Toast(toast);
        bs.show();
        toast.addEventListener('hidden.bs.toast', function() { toast.remove(); });
    }

    if (typeof Sortable !== 'undefined' && document.querySelector('#slaytTable tbody')) {
        new Sortable(document.querySelector('#slaytTable tbody'), {
            animation: 150,
            handle: 'td:first-child',
            onEnd: function(evt) {
                var ids = [];
                document.querySelectorAll('#slaytTable tbody tr[data-id]').forEach(function(row) {
                    ids.push(parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-id')));
                });
                fetch('@Url.Action("Siralama", "Slayt")', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'RequestVerificationToken': document.querySelector('input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]')?.value || ''
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify(ids)
                })
                .then(r => r.json())
                .then(function(data) {
                    if (data.success) {
                        var rows = document.querySelectorAll('#slaytTable tbody tr');
                        rows.forEach(function(row, i) {
                            var badge = row.querySelector('.badge.bg-dark');
                            if (badge) badge.textContent = i + 1;
                        });
                        showToast(orderSavedMessage, 'success');
                    }
                })
                .catch(function() { showToast(orderSaveFailedMessage, 'error'); });
            }
        });
    }
})();
</script>
}

@section Scripts {
<script>
    // Detail Modal
    function showDetail(userId) {
        var modal = document.getElementById('detailModal');
        var body = document.getElementById('detailModalBody');
        var footer = document.getElementById('detailModalFooter');
        modal.classList.add('show');
        body.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-4"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin" style="font-size:1.5rem; color:;"></i><p class="mt-2" style="color:;">@Localizer["Admin_Yukleniyor"]</p></div>';
        footer.style.display = 'none';

        fetch('/Admin/Toptanci/Detay?id=' + encodeURIComponent(userId))
            .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function(d) {
                var avatarIdx = d.adSoyad ? Math.abs(d.adSoyad.split('').reduce(function(a,c){a=((a<<5)-a)+c.charCodeAt(0);return a&a;},0)) % 5 : 0;
                var avatarLetter = d.adSoyad ? d.adSoyad.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : 'U';
                var statusClass = d.wholesaleStatus === 'Pending' ? 'pending' : d.wholesaleStatus === 'Approved' ? 'approved' : 'rejected';
                var statusIcon = d.wholesaleStatus === 'Pending' ? 'fa-clock' : d.wholesaleStatus === 'Approved' ? 'fa-check-circle' : 'fa-times-circle';

                const grid = document.createElement('div');
                grid.className = 'ca-detail-grid';
                const addItem = (label, value, full, empty) => {
                    const item = document.createElement('div');
                    item.className = 'ca-detail-item' + (full ? ' full' : '');
                    const labelNode = document.createElement('div');
                    labelNode.className = 'ca-detail-label';
                    labelNode.textContent = label;
                    const valueNode = document.createElement('div');
                    valueNode.className = 'ca-detail-value' + (empty ? ' empty' : '');
                    valueNode.textContent = value == null || value === '' ? '-' : String(value);
                    item.append(labelNode, valueNode);
                    grid.appendChild(item);
                    return valueNode;
                };

                addItem('@Localizer["Admin_Ad_Soyad"]', d.adSoyad || '-');
                const statusValue = addItem('@Localizer["Admin_Durum"]', '');
                const status = document.createElement('span');
                status.className = 'ca-ws-status ' + statusClass;
                const statusGlyph = document.createElement('i');
                statusGlyph.className = 'fas ' + statusIcon;
                status.append(statusGlyph, document.createTextNode(' ' + (d.statusLabel || '-')));
                statusValue.replaceChildren(status);
                addItem('@Localizer["Admin_E_posta"]', d.email || '-');
                addItem('@Localizer["Admin_Telefon"]', d.phoneNumber || '-');
                addItem('@Localizer["Admin_KimlikNo"]', d.kimlikNo || '-');
                addItem('@Localizer["Admin_DogumTarihi"]', d.dogumTarihi || '-');
                addItem('@Localizer["Admin_Sehir"]', d.sehir || '-');
                addItem('@Localizer["Admin_BasvuruTarihi"]', d.basvuruTarihi || '-');
                addItem('@Localizer["Admin_Adres"]', d.adres || '@Localizer["Admin_Belirtilmemis"]', true, !d.adres);
                addItem('@Localizer["Admin_SiparisSayisi"]', d.siparisSayisi ?? 0);
                addItem('@Localizer["Admin_ToptanciRolu"]', d.isWholesaleRole ? '@Localizer["Admin_Evet"]' : '@Localizer["Admin_Hayir"]');

                const photoValue = addItem('@Localizer["Admin_KimlikFotografi"]', '@Localizer["Admin_YuklenmemisText"]', true, !d.kimlikFotografYolu);
                if (typeof d.kimlikFotografYolu === 'string' && d.kimlikFotografYolu.startsWith('/Belge/')) {
                    const photoLink = document.createElement('a');
                    photoLink.href = d.kimlikFotografYolu;
                    photoLink.target = '_blank';
                    photoLink.rel = 'noopener';
                    photoLink.className = 'ca-detail-photo-link';
                    photoLink.textContent = '@Localizer["Admin_FotografiYeniSekmede"]';
                    const photo = document.createElement('img');
                    photo.src = d.kimlikFotografYolu;
                    photo.className = 'ca-detail-photo';
                    photo.alt = '@Localizer["Admin_KimlikFotografi"]';
                    photoValue.replaceChildren(photoLink, document.createElement('br'), photo);
                }
                body.replaceChildren(grid);

                const antiforgery = document.querySelector('input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]');
                const createActionForm = (action, cssClass, label, confirmText) => {
                    const form = document.createElement('form');
                    form.action = action;
                    form.method = 'post';
                    form.className = 'ws-ajax-form';
                    form.style.margin = '0';
                    const idInput = document.createElement('input');
                    idInput.type = 'hidden';
                    idInput.name = 'id';
                    idInput.value = String(d.id || '');
                    const button = document.createElement('button');
                    button.type = 'submit';
                    button.className = cssClass;
                    button.dataset.confirm = (d.adSoyad || '') + ' ' + confirmText;
                    button.textContent = label;
                    form.append(idInput);
                    if (antiforgery) form.append(antiforgery.cloneNode(true));
                    form.append(button);
                    return form;
                };

                footer.replaceChildren();
                if (d.wholesaleStatus !== 'Approved') {
                    footer.append(createActionForm('/Admin/Toptanci/Onayla', 'ca-ws-btn approve', '@Localizer["Admin_Onayla"]', '@Localizer["Admin_OnaylaConfirmJS"]'));
                }
                if (d.wholesaleStatus !== 'Rejected') {
                    const rejectButton = document.createElement('button');
                    rejectButton.type = 'button';
                    rejectButton.className = 'ca-ws-btn reject';
                    rejectButton.textContent = '@Localizer["Admin_Reddet"]';
                    rejectButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        closeDetailModal();
                        showRejectModal(String(d.id || ''), d.adSoyad || '');
                    });
                    footer.append(rejectButton);
                }
                if (d.wholesaleStatus !== 'Pending') {
                    footer.append(createActionForm('/Admin/Toptanci/Beklemede', 'ca-ws-btn pending-btn', '@Localizer["Admin_BeklemedeyeAl"]', '@Localizer["Admin_BeklemedeyeConfirmJS"]'));
                }
                footer.style.display = 'flex';

                // Re-bind AJAX forms
                bindAjaxForms();
            })
            .catch(function() {
                body.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-4"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle" style="font-size:1.5rem; color:#f59e0b;"></i><p class="mt-2" style="color:#991b1b;">@Localizer["Admin_YuklemeHata"]</p></div>';
            });
    }

    function closeDetailModal() {
        document.getElementById('detailModal').classList.remove('show');
    }

    // Reject Modal
    function showRejectModal(userId, userName) {
        document.getElementById('rejectUserId').value = userId;
        document.getElementById('rejectUserName').textContent = userName;
        document.querySelector('#rejectForm textarea').value = '';
        document.getElementById('rejectModal').classList.add('show');
    }

    function closeRejectModal() {
        document.getElementById('rejectModal').classList.remove('show');
    }

    function submitReject() {
        var form = document.getElementById('rejectForm');
        var btn = document.querySelector('#rejectModal .ca-ws-btn.reject');
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> @Localizer["Admin_Isleniyor"]';

        var formData = new FormData(form);
        fetch(form.getAttribute('action') || '/Admin/Toptanci/Reddet', {
            method: 'POST',
            body: formData
        }).then(function() {
            showToast('@Localizer["Admin_BasvuruReddedildi"]', 'success');
            setTimeout(function() { location.reload(); }, 800);
        }).catch(function() {
            showToast('@Localizer["Admin_IslemHata"]', 'error');
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-times"></i> @Localizer["Admin_Reddet"]';
        });
    }

    // AJAX form handling
    function bindAjaxForms() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.ws-ajax-form').forEach(function(form) {
            form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                var btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
                var confirmMsg = btn.getAttribute('data-confirm');
                if (confirmMsg && !confirm(confirmMsg)) return;

                btn.disabled = true;
                var originalHtml = btn.innerHTML;
                btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i>';

                var formData = new FormData(form);
                fetch(form.getAttribute('action'), {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: formData
                }).then(function() {
                    var row = form.closest('tr');
                    if (row) {
                        row.style.transition = 'opacity .3s';
                        row.style.opacity = '0';
                    }
                    showToast('@Localizer["Admin_IslemBasarili"]', 'success');
                    setTimeout(function() { location.reload(); }, 600);
                }).catch(function() {
                    showToast('@Localizer["Admin_IslemHata"]', 'error');
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.innerHTML = originalHtml;
                });
            });
        });
    }

    // Toast notification
    function showToast(message, type) {
        var existing = document.querySelector('.ca-toast');
        if (existing) existing.remove();

        var toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.className = 'ca-toast ' + type;
        var icon = document.createElement('i');
        icon.className = 'fas ' + (type === 'success' ? 'fa-check-circle' : 'fa-exclamation-circle');
        toast.append(icon, document.createTextNode(' ' + String(message || '')));
        document.body.appendChild(toast);
        setTimeout(function() { toast.remove(); }, 3000);
    }

    // Close modals on overlay click
    document.querySelectorAll('.ca-modal-overlay').forEach(function(overlay) {
        overlay.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target === this) this.classList.remove('show');
        });
    });

    // Close on Escape
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            document.querySelectorAll('.ca-modal-overlay.show').forEach(function(m) { m.classList.remove('show'); });
        }
    });

    // Bind on load
    bindAjaxForms();
</script>
}

========== FilistinProje.Web\Areas\Admin\Views\Urun\_FeatureEditor.cshtml ==========
@model FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.Urun
@using FilistinProje.Service.Helpers
@{
    var definitions = (ViewBag.OzellikTanimlari as IEnumerable<FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.UrunOzellikTanimi> ?? Enumerable.Empty<FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.UrunOzellikTanimi>())
        .OrderBy(x => x.Sira)
        .ThenBy(x => x.Ad)
        .ToList();

    var currentValues = (Model.UrunOzellikleri ?? Enumerable.Empty<FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.UrunOzellikDegeri>())
        .Where(x => !x.SilindiMi)
        .GroupBy(x => x.UrunOzellikTanimiId)
        .ToDictionary(x => x.Key.ToString(), x => (x.Last().Deger ?? string.Empty).Trim());

    var definitionPayload = definitions.Select(x => new
    {
        id = x.Id,
        ad = (x.Ad ?? string.Empty).Trim(),
        urunTipi = x.UrunTipi,
        alanTipi = x.AlanTipi,
        yardimMetni = (x.YardimMetni ?? string.Empty).Trim(),
        secenekler = x.SecenekListesi.Select(s => (s ?? string.Empty).Trim()).ToList(),
        filtredeGoster = x.FiltredeGoster,
        detaySayfasindaGoster = x.DetaySayfasindaGoster,
        teknikTablodaGoster = x.TeknikTablodaGoster,
        sira = x.Sira
    });

    var definitionsJson = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(definitionPayload);
    var valuesJson = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(currentValues);
}

<div class="ca-card mt-4" style="border:1px solid var(--ca-border);">
    <div class="ca-card-header">
        <span class="ca-card-title">@Localizer["Admin_ProductTypeAndFeatures"]</span>
    </div>
    <div class="ca-card-body">
        <div class="row g-3 align-items-start">
            <div class="col-lg-4">
                <div class="ca-form-group mb-0">
                    <label class="ca-label">@Localizer["Admin_ProductType"]</label>
                    <select asp-for="UrunTipi" asp-items="ViewBag.UrunTipleri" class="ca-select" id="productTypeSelect"></select>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="col-lg-8">
                <div class="alert alert-light border mb-0">
                    @Localizer["Admin_ProductTypeHelp"]
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div id="productFeatureSummary" class="small text-muted mt-3"></div>
        <div id="productFeatureContainer" class="row g-3 mt-1"></div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    (function () {
        const definitions = @Html.Raw(definitionsJson);
        const featureValues = @Html.Raw(valuesJson);
        const typeSelect = document.getElementById('productTypeSelect');
        const container = document.getElementById('productFeatureContainer');
        const summary = document.getElementById('productFeatureSummary');
        const yesText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_Yes"].Value));
        const noText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_No"].Value));
        const selectText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_Select"].Value));
        const noFeatureFieldsText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_NoFeatureFieldsForType"].Value));
        const featureSummaryText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_FeatureSummary"].Value));
        const filterText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_Filter"].Value));
        const detailText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_Detay"].Value));
        const technicalText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_Technical"].Value));

        if (!typeSelect || !container) {
            return;
        }

        function escapeHtml(value) {
            return (value || '')
                .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
                .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
                .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
                .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
                .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
        }

        function captureCurrentValues() {
            container.querySelectorAll('[data-feature-input]').forEach((input) => {
                const definitionId = input.getAttribute('data-definition-id');
                if (!definitionId) {
                    return;
                }

                featureValues[definitionId] = input.value || '';
            });
        }

        function buildInput(definition, index, value) {
            const fieldName = `UrunOzellikleri[${index}].Deger`;
            const hidden = `<input type="hidden" name="UrunOzellikleri[${index}].UrunOzellikTanimiId" value="${definition.id}" />`;
            const escapedValue = escapeHtml(value);

            if (definition.alanTipi === 'textarea') {
                return `${hidden}<textarea class="ca-textarea" rows="3" name="${fieldName}" data-feature-input data-definition-id="${definition.id}">${escapedValue}</textarea>`;
            }

            if (definition.alanTipi === 'number') {
                return `${hidden}<input class="ca-input" type="number" step="0.01" name="${fieldName}" value="${escapedValue}" data-feature-input data-definition-id="${definition.id}" />`;
            }

            if (definition.alanTipi === 'select') {
                const options = (definition.secenekler || []).map((option) => {
                    const normalized = option === 'true' ? yesText : (option === 'false' ? noText : option);
                    const selected = option === value ? 'selected' : '';
                    return `<option value="${escapeHtml(option)}" ${selected}>${escapeHtml(normalized)}</option>`;
                }).join('');

                return `${hidden}<select class="ca-select" name="${fieldName}" data-feature-input data-definition-id="${definition.id}"><option value="">${selectText}</option>${options}</select>`;
            }

            return `${hidden}<input class="ca-input" type="text" name="${fieldName}" value="${escapedValue}" data-feature-input data-definition-id="${definition.id}" />`;
        }

        function renderFeatures() {
            captureCurrentValues();

            const selectedType = typeSelect.value || 'Genel';
            const visibleDefinitions = definitions
                .filter((definition) => definition.urunTipi === 'Genel' || definition.urunTipi === selectedType)
                .sort((a, b) => (a.sira - b.sira) || a.ad.localeCompare(b.ad, 'tr'));

            container.innerHTML = '';

            if (visibleDefinitions.length === 0) {
                summary.textContent = noFeatureFieldsText;
                return;
            }

            const filterableCount = visibleDefinitions.filter((definition) => definition.filtredeGoster).length;
            summary.textContent = featureSummaryText.replace('{0}', visibleDefinitions.length).replace('{1}', filterableCount);

            visibleDefinitions.forEach((definition, index) => {
                const value = featureValues[definition.id.toString()] || '';
                const badges = [];
                if (definition.filtredeGoster) badges.push(`<span class="badge text-bg-light border">${filterText}</span>`);
                if (definition.detaySayfasindaGoster) badges.push(`<span class="badge text-bg-light border">${detailText}</span>`);
                if (definition.teknikTablodaGoster) badges.push(`<span class="badge text-bg-light border">${technicalText}</span>`);

                const col = document.createElement('div');
                col.className = definition.alanTipi === 'textarea' ? 'col-12' : 'col-lg-6';
                col.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="ca-card" style="border:1px solid var(--ca-border); box-shadow:none;">
                        <div class="ca-card-body">
                            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start gap-2 mb-2">
                                <div>
                                    <div class="fw-semibold">${escapeHtml(definition.ad)}</div>
                                    ${definition.yardimMetni ? `<div class="small text-muted mt-1">${escapeHtml(definition.yardimMetni)}</div>` : ''}
                                </div>
                                <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-1 justify-content-end">${badges.join('')}</div>
                            </div>
                            ${buildInput(definition, index, value)}
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
                container.appendChild(col);
            });
        }

        typeSelect.addEventListener('change', renderFeatures);
        renderFeatures();
    })();
</script>

<script>
    (function () {
        const form = document.querySelector('form[asp-action], form');
        const list = document.getElementById('variantList');
        const template = document.getElementById('variantCardTemplate');
        const emptyState = document.getElementById('variantEmptyState');
        const categorySelect = document.querySelector('[name="KategoriId"]');
        const canvasOptionCategoryIds = new Set(@Html.Raw(canvasOptionCategoryIdJson));
        const canvasFields = ['Olcu', 'CerceveTipi', 'CerceveRengi', 'CerceveKalinligi', 'MalzemeTuru', 'ParcaSayisi'];
        const pieceText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_Piece"].Value.ToLowerInvariant()));
        const personalizationPrefixText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_PersonalizationPrefix"].Value));
        const variationSubtitleDefaultText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_VariationSubtitleDefault"].Value));

        if (!list || !template) {
            return;
        }

        function selector(card, fieldName) {
            return card.querySelector(`[data-variant-field="${fieldName}"]`);
        }

        function supportsCanvasOptions() {
            const categoryId = parseInt(categorySelect?.value || '0', 10);
            return canvasOptionCategoryIds.has(categoryId);
        }

        function clearCanvasFields(card) {
            canvasFields.forEach((field) => {
                const input = selector(card, field);
                if (!input) {
                    return;
                }

                input.value = field === 'ParcaSayisi' ? '1' : '';
            });
        }

        function applyCategoryScope() {
            const enabled = supportsCanvasOptions();
            list.querySelectorAll('[data-canvas-option]').forEach((el) => {
                el.classList.toggle('ca-canvas-option-hidden', !enabled);
            });

            if (!enabled) {
                list.querySelectorAll('[data-variant-card]').forEach(clearCanvasFields);
            }
        }

        function toggleEmptyState() {
            if (!emptyState) {
                return;
            }

            emptyState.classList.toggle('d-none', list.querySelectorAll('[data-variant-card]').length > 0);
        }

        function buildTitle(card, index) {
            const canvasEnabled = supportsCanvasOptions();
            const olcu = canvasEnabled ? selector(card, 'Olcu')?.value?.trim() || '' : '';
            const cerceve = canvasEnabled ? selector(card, 'CerceveTipi')?.value?.trim() || '' : '';
            const renk = canvasEnabled ? selector(card, 'CerceveRengi')?.value?.trim() || '' : '';
            const sku = selector(card, 'VaryantSku')?.value?.trim() || '';

            const baseTitle = [olcu, cerceve, renk].filter(Boolean).join(' / ');
            if (baseTitle) {
                return baseTitle;
            }

            if (sku) {
                return sku;
            }

            return `Varyasyon ${index + 1}`;
        }

        function buildSubtitle(card) {
            const canvasEnabled = supportsCanvasOptions();
            const malzeme = canvasEnabled ? selector(card, 'MalzemeTuru')?.value?.trim() || '' : '';
            const yon = selector(card, 'Yon')?.value?.trim() || '';
            const kisellestirme = selector(card, 'KisilestirmeMetni')?.value?.trim() || '';
            const not = selector(card, 'OzelTasarimNotu')?.value?.trim() || '';
            const parca = canvasEnabled ? parseInt(selector(card, 'ParcaSayisi')?.value || '1', 10) : 1;

            const parts = [];
            if (malzeme) parts.push(malzeme);
            if (yon) parts.push(yon);
            if (parca > 1) parts.push(`${parca} ${pieceText}`);
            if (kisellestirme) parts.push(personalizationPrefixText.replace('{0}', kisellestirme));
            if (not) parts.push(`Not: ${not}`);

            return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(' | ') : variationSubtitleDefaultText;
        }

        function syncDefaultCheckbox(activeCheckbox) {
            if (!activeCheckbox.checked) {
                return;
            }

            list.querySelectorAll('[data-variant-default]').forEach((checkbox) => {
                if (checkbox !== activeCheckbox) {
                    checkbox.checked = false;
                }
            });
        }

        function reindex() {
            applyCategoryScope();

            list.querySelectorAll('[data-variant-card]').forEach((card, index) => {
                card.dataset.index = index;

                card.querySelectorAll('[data-variant-field]').forEach((input) => {
                    const field = input.getAttribute('data-variant-field');
                    input.name = `UrunSecenek[${index}].${field}`;

                    if (input.type !== 'hidden') {
                        const id = `variant_${field}_${index}`;
                        input.id = id;
                        const label = card.querySelector(`[data-label-for="${field}"]`);
                        if (label) {
                            label.htmlFor = id;
                        }
                    }
                });

                card.querySelectorAll('input[type="hidden"][name^="UrunSecenek["]').forEach((input) => {
                    input.name = input.name.replace(/UrunSecenek\[[^\]]+\]\./, `UrunSecenek[${index}].`);
                });

                const title = card.querySelector('[data-variant-title]');
                const subtitle = card.querySelector('[data-variant-subtitle]');

                if (title) {
                    title.textContent = buildTitle(card, index);
                }

                if (subtitle) {
                    subtitle.textContent = buildSubtitle(card);
                }
            });

            toggleEmptyState();
        }

        function bindCard(card) {
            card.querySelectorAll('input, textarea').forEach((input) => {
                input.addEventListener('input', () => reindex());
                input.addEventListener('change', () => reindex());
            });

            const removeButton = card.querySelector('[data-variant-remove]');
            if (removeButton) {
                removeButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    card.remove();
                    reindex();
                });
            }

            const defaultCheckbox = card.querySelector('[data-variant-default]');
            if (defaultCheckbox) {
                defaultCheckbox.addEventListener('change', function () {
                    syncDefaultCheckbox(this);
                    reindex();
                });
            }
        }

        function addCard() {
            const index = list.querySelectorAll('[data-variant-card]').length;
            const html = template.innerHTML.replaceAll('__index__', index.toString());
            list.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
            const card = list.querySelector('[data-variant-card]:last-child');
            if (card) {
                bindCard(card);
            }
            reindex();
        }

        list.querySelectorAll('[data-variant-card]').forEach(bindCard);
        reindex();

        if (form) {
            form.addEventListener('submit', () => {
                if (!supportsCanvasOptions()) {
                    list.querySelectorAll('[data-variant-card]').forEach(clearCanvasFields);
                }

                list.querySelectorAll('input[type="number"]').forEach((input) => {
                    if (input.value === '') {
                        input.value = input.min && parseFloat(input.min) > 0 ? input.min : '0';
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        if (categorySelect) {
            categorySelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
                applyCategoryScope();
                reindex();
            });
        }

        window.caVariantEditor = {
            add: addCard,
            refresh: reindex
        };
    })();
</script>

@model FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.Urun
@{
    Layout = "~/Areas/Admin/Views/Shared/_AdminLayout.cshtml";
    ViewData["Title"] = Localizer["Admin_EditProduct"];
    var detailUrl = "/Urun/Detay/" + (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.Slug) ? Model.Id.ToString() : Model.Slug + "-" + Model.Id);
    var variantCount = Model.UrunSecenek?.Count(x => !x.SilindiMi) ?? 0;
    var mediaCount = Model.UrunResimleri?.Count(x => !x.SilindiMi) ?? 0;
    var previewItems = new List<(string Type, string Url, string Poster, string Alt)>();

    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.AnaGorselUrl))
    {
        previewItems.Add(("image", Model.AnaGorselUrl, Model.AnaGorselUrl, $"{Model.Baslik} - الصورة الرئيسية"));
    }

    foreach (var media in (Model.UrunResimleri ?? Enumerable.Empty<FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.UrunResim>())
        .Where(x => !x.SilindiMi)
        .OrderByDescending(x => x.VarsayilanMi)
        .ThenBy(x => x.Sira)
        .ThenBy(x => x.Id))
    {
        var mediaUrl = media.VideoMu
            ? (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(media.ResimYolu) ? media.VideoUrl : media.ResimYolu)
            : (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(media.ResimYolu) ? media.EtkinPosterYolu : media.ResimYolu);

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(mediaUrl))
        {
            continue;
        }

        previewItems.Add((
            media.VideoMu ? "video" : "image",
            mediaUrl,
            media.EtkinPosterYolu ?? string.Empty,
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(media.AltMetin) ? Model.Baslik : media.AltMetin));
    }

    previewItems = previewItems
        .GroupBy(x => $"{x.Type}|{x.Url}", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        .Select(x => x.First())
        .ToList();
}

<script>
    (function () {
        const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[data-product-tab]');
        const panels = document.querySelectorAll('[data-product-panel]');
        const storageKey = '7anrps48-product-editor-tab';

        function activate(name) {
            tabs.forEach((tab) => tab.classList.toggle('active', tab.dataset.productTab === name));
            panels.forEach((panel) => panel.classList.toggle('active', panel.dataset.productPanel === name));
            localStorage.setItem(storageKey, name);
        }

        tabs.forEach((tab) => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => activate(tab.dataset.productTab));
        });

        const initial = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
        if (initial && document.querySelector(`[data-product-tab="${initial}"]`)) {
            activate(initial);
        }
    })();

    (function () {
        const slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-preview-slide]'));
        const prevButton = document.querySelector('[data-preview-prev]');
        const nextButton = document.querySelector('[data-preview-next]');
        const counter = document.querySelector('[data-preview-counter]');
        let activeIndex = 0;

        if (!slides.length) {
            return;
        }

        function pauseVideos() {
            slides.forEach((slide) => {
                const video = slide.querySelector('video');
                if (video && !video.paused) {
                    video.pause();
                }
            });
        }

        function showSlide(index) {
            activeIndex = (index + slides.length) % slides.length;
            pauseVideos();

            slides.forEach((slide, slideIndex) => {
                slide.classList.toggle('active', slideIndex === activeIndex);
            });

            if (counter) {
                counter.textContent = `${activeIndex + 1} / ${slides.length}`;
            }
        }

        prevButton?.addEventListener('click', () => showSlide(activeIndex - 1));
        nextButton?.addEventListener('click', () => showSlide(activeIndex + 1));
    })();

    function previewFile(event, id) {
        const file = event.target.files && event.target.files[0];
        if (!file) return;
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = () => document.getElementById(id).src = reader.result;
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }

    function updatePreviewFromUrl(inputId, previewId) {
        const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
        const preview = document.getElementById(previewId);
        if (input && preview) {
            preview.src = input.value;
        }
    }
</script>

<script>
    (function () {
        const titleInput = document.getElementById('createTitle');
        const liveTitle = document.getElementById('liveTitle');
        const slugInput = document.getElementById('slugInput');
        const seoUrlInput = document.getElementById('seoUrlInput');
        const mainImgUrl = document.getElementById('mainImgUrl');
        const galleryFiles = document.getElementById('galleryFiles');
        const galleryFileInfo = document.getElementById('galleryFileInfo');
        const productNameEmptyText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_ProductNameEmpty"].Value));
        const additionalImagesHelpText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_AdditionalImagesHelp"].Value));
        const autoCreateAfterSaveText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_AutoCreateAfterSave"].Value));
        const additionalImagesSelectedText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_AdditionalImagesSelected"].Value));
        window.autoCreateAfterSaveText = autoCreateAfterSaveText;

        if (mainImgUrl && mainImgUrl.value.startsWith(autoCreateAfterSaveText)) {
            mainImgUrl.value = '';
        }

        function createSlug(value) {
            const map = {
                'ç': 'c', 'Ç': 'c',
                'ğ': 'g', 'Ğ': 'g',
                'ı': 'i', 'I': 'i',
                'İ': 'i', 'i': 'i',
                'ö': 'o', 'Ö': 'o',
                'ş': 's', 'Ş': 's',
                'ü': 'u', 'Ü': 'u'
            };

            return (value || '')
                .split('')
                .map((char) => map[char] || char)
                .join('')
                .toLowerCase()
                .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
                .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
                .replace(/-{2,}/g, '-');
        }

        titleInput?.addEventListener('input', function () {
            const title = titleInput.value.trim();
            const slug = createSlug(title);
            liveTitle.textContent = title || productNameEmptyText;
            if (slugInput) slugInput.value = slug;
            if (seoUrlInput) seoUrlInput.value = slug;
        });

        galleryFiles?.addEventListener('change', function () {
            const count = galleryFiles.files ? galleryFiles.files.length : 0;
            galleryFileInfo.textContent = count > 0
                ? additionalImagesSelectedText.replace('{0}', count)
                : additionalImagesHelpText;
        });
    })();

    function previewFile(event, id, fileNameId) {
        const file = event.target.files && event.target.files[0];
        if (!file) return;
        const urlInput = document.getElementById('mainImgUrl');
        if (urlInput) {
            urlInput.value = '';
            urlInput.placeholder = window.autoCreateAfterSaveText + ' ' + file.name;
        }
        const fileName = document.getElementById(fileNameId);
        if (fileName) fileName.textContent = file.name;
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = () => document.getElementById(id).src = reader.result;
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }

    function updatePreviewFromUrl(inputId, previewId) {
        const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
        const preview = document.getElementById(previewId);
        if (input && preview && input.value.trim()) {
            preview.src = input.value.trim();
        }
    }
</script>

@using FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar
@model IEnumerable<Urun>
@inject FilistinProje.Data.KanvasDbContext DbContext

@{
    ViewData["Title"] = Localizer["Admin_Urun_Yonetimi"];
    Layout = "~/Areas/Admin/Views/Shared/_AdminLayout.cshtml";

    var currentSearch = ViewBag.CurrentSearch as string ?? string.Empty;
    int? currentKategori = ViewBag.CurrentKategori as int?;
    var currentPage = ViewBag.Page as int? ?? 1;
    var pageSize = ViewBag.PageSize as int? ?? 20;
    var totalPages = ViewBag.TotalPages as int? ?? 1;
    var totalCount = ViewBag.TotalCount as int? ?? Model.Count();
    var pageSizeOptions = ViewBag.PageSizeOptions as int[] ?? new[] { 20, 50, 100 };
    var kategoriler = DbContext.Kategoriler.OrderBy(x => x.Sira).ThenBy(x => x.Ad).ToList();

    string BuildUrl(int? pageValue = null, int? pageSizeValue = null)
    {
        var query = new List<string>();
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(currentSearch)) query.Add($"search={Uri.EscapeDataString(currentSearch)}");
        if (currentKategori.HasValue) query.Add($"kategoriId={currentKategori.Value}");
        query.Add($"page={pageValue ?? currentPage}");
        query.Add($"pageSize={pageSizeValue ?? pageSize}");
        return "/Admin/Urun?" + string.Join("&", query);
    }
}

<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const checkboxes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.product-select'));
        const selectAll = document.getElementById('selectAllProducts');
        const bulkButtons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.bulk-product-button'));
        const selectedText = document.getElementById('selectedProductCount');
        const bulkForm = document.getElementById('bulkProductActionForm');
        const hiddenInputs = document.getElementById('bulkProductActionInputs');
        const noSelectedProductText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_NoSelectedProduct"].Value));
        const selectedProductCountText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_SelectedProductCount"].Value));

        function selectedValues() {
            return checkboxes.filter(x => x.checked).map(x => x.value);
        }

        function refreshBulkState() {
            const values = selectedValues();
            bulkButtons.forEach(x => x.disabled = values.length === 0);
            if (selectedText) {
                selectedText.textContent = values.length === 0
                    ? noSelectedProductText
                    : selectedProductCountText.replace('{0}', values.length);
            }
            if (selectAll) {
                selectAll.checked = values.length > 0 && values.length === checkboxes.length;
                selectAll.indeterminate = values.length > 0 && values.length < checkboxes.length;
            }
        }

        if (selectAll) {
            selectAll.addEventListener('change', function () {
                checkboxes.forEach(x => x.checked = selectAll.checked);
                refreshBulkState();
            });
        }

        checkboxes.forEach(function (checkbox) {
            checkbox.addEventListener('change', refreshBulkState);
        });

        if (bulkForm) {
            bulkForm.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
                const values = selectedValues();
                if (values.length === 0) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    return;
                }

                hiddenInputs.innerHTML = '';
                values.forEach(function (id) {
                    const input = document.createElement('input');
                    input.type = 'hidden';
                    input.name = 'urunIds';
                    input.value = id;
                    hiddenInputs.appendChild(input);
                });
            });
        }

        refreshBulkState();
    });
</script>

    var pageSize = ViewBag.PageSize is int ps ? ps : 20;
    var totalPages = ViewBag.TotalPages is int tp ? tp : 1;

    var pendingCount = ViewBag.PendingCount is int pc ? pc : 0;

    string StatusUrl(int targetStatus) => $"/Admin/Yorum?durum={targetStatus}&pageSize={pageSize}";
    string PageUrl(int targetPage) => $"/Admin/Yorum?durum={durum}&q={Uri.EscapeDataString(search)}&page={targetPage}&pageSize={pageSize}";
    string ExportUrl() => $"/Admin/Yorum/Export?durum={durum}&q={Uri.EscapeDataString(search)}";

    static string Shorten(string? value, int max)
    {
        value = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? string.Empty : value.Trim();
        return value.Length <= max ? value : value[..max] + "...";
    }

@section Scripts {
    <script>
        (function () {
            const selectAll = document.getElementById('selectAllReviews');
            const checkboxes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ca-review-checkbox'));
             const bulkButton = document.getElementById('bulkApproveButton');
             const approveSelectedText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_ApproveSelected"].Value));
             const approveNReviewsText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Admin_ApproveNReviews"].Value));

            function refreshBulkState() {
                const selected = checkboxes.filter(x => x.checked).length;
                if (bulkButton) {
                    bulkButton.disabled = selected === 0;
                    bulkButton.innerHTML = selected === 0
                         ? `<i class="fas fa-check-double"></i> ${approveSelectedText}`
                         : `<i class="fas fa-check-double"></i> ${approveNReviewsText.replace('{0}', selected)}`;
                }

                if (selectAll) {
                    selectAll.checked = selected > 0 && selected === checkboxes.length;
                    selectAll.indeterminate = selected > 0 && selected < checkboxes.length;
                }
            }

            selectAll?.addEventListener('change', function () {
                checkboxes.forEach(x => x.checked = selectAll.checked);
                refreshBulkState();
            });

            checkboxes.forEach(x => x.addEventListener('change', refreshBulkState));
            refreshBulkState();
        })();
    </script>
}

@model FilistinProje.Core.Models.ZiyaretciIndexViewModel
@functions {
    private static readonly TimeZoneInfo PalestineTimeZone = ResolvePalestineTimeZone();

    private static DateTime ToPalestineLocal(DateTime value)
    {
        var utcValue = value.Kind == DateTimeKind.Utc
            ? value
            : DateTime.SpecifyKind(value, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        return TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(utcValue, PalestineTimeZone);
    }

    private static TimeZoneInfo ResolvePalestineTimeZone()
    {
        foreach (var timeZoneId in new[] { "Asia/Gaza", "West Bank Standard Time" })
        {
            try
            {
                return TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById(timeZoneId);
            }
            catch (TimeZoneNotFoundException) { }
            catch (InvalidTimeZoneException) { }
        }

        return TimeZoneInfo.Utc;
    }
}
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = Localizer["Admin_VisitorTraffic"];
    Layout = "~/Areas/Admin/Views/Shared/_AdminLayout.cshtml";

    string BuildUrl(int? page = null, int? pageSize = null)
    {
        var query = new List<string>();
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.Arama)) query.Add($"q={Uri.EscapeDataString(Model.Arama)}");
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.Metod)) query.Add($"metod={Uri.EscapeDataString(Model.Metod)}");
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.Cihaz)) query.Add($"cihaz={Uri.EscapeDataString(Model.Cihaz)}");
        if (Model.Baslangic.HasValue) query.Add($"baslangic={Model.Baslangic.Value:yyyy-MM-dd}");
        if (Model.Bitis.HasValue) query.Add($"bitis={Model.Bitis.Value:yyyy-MM-dd}");
        query.Add($"page={page ?? Model.Page}");
        query.Add($"pageSize={pageSize ?? Model.PageSize}");
        return "/Admin/Ziyaretci?" + string.Join("&", query);
    }

    string ExportUrl()
    {
        var query = new List<string>();
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.Arama)) query.Add($"q={Uri.EscapeDataString(Model.Arama)}");
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.Metod)) query.Add($"metod={Uri.EscapeDataString(Model.Metod)}");
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.Cihaz)) query.Add($"cihaz={Uri.EscapeDataString(Model.Cihaz)}");
        if (Model.Baslangic.HasValue) query.Add($"baslangic={Model.Baslangic.Value:yyyy-MM-dd}");
        if (Model.Bitis.HasValue) query.Add($"bitis={Model.Bitis.Value:yyyy-MM-dd}");
        return "/Admin/Ziyaretci/Export" + (query.Count > 0 ? "?" + string.Join("&", query) : string.Empty);
    }
}

========== FilistinProje.Web\Attributes\ZiyaretciTakipAttribute.cs ==========
using System.IO;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using FilistinProje.Web.Services;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Filters;

namespace FilistinProje.Web.Attributes
{
    public class ZiyaretciTakipAttribute : ActionFilterAttribute
    {
        private readonly IVisitorTrackingQueue _queue;

        private static readonly Regex SensitiveQueryParamPattern = new(
            @"\b(token|password|sifre|secret|key|code|auth|hash|signature|reset|confirm|verif|credential)\b",
            RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);

        public ZiyaretciTakipAttribute(IVisitorTrackingQueue queue)
        {
            _queue = queue;
        }

        public override async Task OnActionExecutionAsync(ActionExecutingContext context, ActionExecutionDelegate next)
        {
            var request = context.HttpContext.Request;
            if (ShouldSkip(request))
            {
                await next();
                return;
            }

            var ipAdresi = ResolveIpAddress(context);
            var userAgent = request.Headers.UserAgent.ToString();
            var cihazBilgi = CihazModeliBul(userAgent);
            var sanitizedPath = SanitizeLogPath(request);
            await next();

            _queue.TryEnqueue(new VisitorTrackingEntry(
                ipAdresi,
                Truncate(sanitizedPath, 1000) ?? string.Empty,
                request.Method,
                Truncate(request.Headers.Referer.ToString(), 500),
                Truncate(userAgent, 512) ?? string.Empty,
                cihazBilgi.Tarayici,
                cihazBilgi.OS,
                cihazBilgi.Model,
                    context.HttpContext.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true
                        ? Truncate(context.HttpContext.User.Identity.Name, 256)
                        : "زائر",
                DateTime.UtcNow));
        }

        private static string SanitizeLogPath(HttpRequest request)
        {
            var path = request.Path.Value ?? string.Empty;

            if (!request.QueryString.HasValue)
                return path;

            var queryString = request.QueryString.Value ?? string.Empty;
            if (SensitiveQueryParamPattern.IsMatch(queryString))
                return path + "?[filtered]";

            return path + queryString;
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkip(HttpRequest request)
        {
            var path = request.Path.Value ?? string.Empty;
            return path.Contains("/admin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                || path.StartsWith("/api", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                || path.StartsWith("/health", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                || !HttpMethods.IsGet(request.Method)
                || Path.HasExtension(path)
                || IsLikelyBot(request.Headers.UserAgent.ToString());
        }

        private static string ResolveIpAddress(FilterContext context)
        {
            return context.HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString()
                ?? "غير معروف";
        }

        private static bool IsLikelyBot(string userAgent)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(userAgent))
            {
                return true;
            }

            string[] markers = ["bot", "crawler", "spider", "slurp", "headless", "monitor", "healthcheck"];
            return markers.Any(marker => userAgent.Contains(marker, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }

        private static string? Truncate(string? value, int maximumLength) =>
            string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)
                ? value
                : value.Length <= maximumLength ? value : value[..maximumLength];

        private static (string Tarayici, string OS, string Model) CihazModeliBul(string agent)
        {
            var os = "غير معروف";
            var browser = "غير معروف";
            var model = "PC / غير معروف";

            if (agent.Contains("Windows", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) os = "Windows";
            else if (agent.Contains("Android", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) os = "Android";
            else if (agent.Contains("iPhone", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || agent.Contains("iPad", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) os = "iOS";
            else if (agent.Contains("Mac", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) os = "MacOS";
            else if (agent.Contains("Linux", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) os = "Linux";

            if (agent.Contains("Edg", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) browser = "Edge";
            else if (agent.Contains("Chrome", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) browser = "Chrome";
            else if (agent.Contains("Firefox", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) browser = "Firefox";
            else if (agent.Contains("Safari", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) browser = "Safari";
            else if (agent.Contains("Opera", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || agent.Contains("OPR", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) browser = "Opera";

            if (os == "Android")
            {
                var match = Regex.Match(agent, @";\s?([^;]+)\sBuild");
                model = match.Success ? match.Groups[1].Value.Trim() : "جهاز Android";
            }
            else if (os == "iOS")
            {
                model = agent.Contains("iPad", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "iPad" : "iPhone";
            }
            else if (os == "Windows")
            {
                model = "PC (Windows)";
            }
            else if (os == "MacOS")
            {
                model = "Macbook / iMac";
            }

            return (browser, os, model);
        }
    }
}


========== FilistinProje.Web\Caching\AdminCounterCache.cs ==========
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;

namespace FilistinProje.Web.Caching;

public static class AdminCounterCacheKeys
{
    public const string PendingOrders = "admin:counter:pending-orders:v1";
    public const string UnreadMessages = "admin:counter:unread-messages:v1";
    public const string OnlineVisitors = "admin:counter:online-visitors:v1";
    public static readonly TimeSpan MaximumStaleTime = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1);
}

public static class AdminCounterCache
{
    private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, SemaphoreSlim> KeyLocks = new();

    public static async Task<int> GetOrCreateAsync(
        IMemoryCache cache,
        string key,
        Func<Task<int>> factory)
    {
        if (cache.TryGetValue(key, out int cached))
        {
            return cached;
        }

        var keyLock = KeyLocks.GetOrAdd(key, _ => new SemaphoreSlim(1, 1));
        await keyLock.WaitAsync();
        try
        {
            if (cache.TryGetValue(key, out cached))
            {
                return cached;
            }

            var value = await factory();
            cache.Set(key, value, AdminCounterCacheKeys.MaximumStaleTime);
            return value;
        }
        finally
        {
            keyLock.Release();
        }
    }

    public static void InvalidateOrders(this IMemoryCache cache) =>
        cache.Remove(AdminCounterCacheKeys.PendingOrders);

    public static void InvalidateMessages(this IMemoryCache cache) =>
        cache.Remove(AdminCounterCacheKeys.UnreadMessages);
}


========== FilistinProje.Web\Caching\AdminCounterInvalidationInterceptor.cs ==========
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Diagnostics;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;

namespace FilistinProje.Web.Caching;

public sealed class AdminCounterInvalidationInterceptor : SaveChangesInterceptor
{
    private sealed record PendingInvalidation(bool Orders, bool Messages);

    private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;
    private readonly ConditionalWeakTable<DbContext, PendingInvalidation> _pending = new();

    public AdminCounterInvalidationInterceptor(IMemoryCache cache)
    {
        _cache = cache;
    }

    public override InterceptionResult<int> SavingChanges(
        DbContextEventData eventData,
        InterceptionResult<int> result)
    {
        Capture(eventData.Context);
        return result;
    }

    public override ValueTask<InterceptionResult<int>> SavingChangesAsync(
        DbContextEventData eventData,
        InterceptionResult<int> result,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        Capture(eventData.Context);
        return ValueTask.FromResult(result);
    }

    public override int SavedChanges(SaveChangesCompletedEventData eventData, int result)
    {
        Invalidate(eventData.Context);
        return result;
    }

    public override ValueTask<int> SavedChangesAsync(
        SaveChangesCompletedEventData eventData,
        int result,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        Invalidate(eventData.Context);
        return ValueTask.FromResult(result);
    }

    public override void SaveChangesFailed(DbContextErrorEventData eventData) =>
        Clear(eventData.Context);

    public override Task SaveChangesFailedAsync(
        DbContextErrorEventData eventData,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        Clear(eventData.Context);
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private void Capture(DbContext? context)
    {
        if (context == null)
        {
            return;
        }

        var orders = context.ChangeTracker.Entries<Siparis>()
            .Any(entry => entry.State is EntityState.Added or EntityState.Deleted ||
                          (entry.State == EntityState.Modified && entry.Property(x => x.Durum).IsModified));
        var messages = context.ChangeTracker.Entries<IletisimMesaj>()
            .Any(entry => entry.State is EntityState.Added or EntityState.Modified or EntityState.Deleted);

        _pending.Remove(context);
        if (orders || messages)
        {
            _pending.Add(context, new PendingInvalidation(orders, messages));
        }
    }

    private void Invalidate(DbContext? context)
    {
        if (context == null || !_pending.TryGetValue(context, out var pending))
        {
            return;
        }

        if (pending.Orders)
        {
            _cache.InvalidateOrders();
        }

        if (pending.Messages)
        {
            _cache.InvalidateMessages();
        }

        _pending.Remove(context);
    }

    private void Clear(DbContext? context)
    {
        if (context != null)
        {
            _pending.Remove(context);
        }
    }
}

using FilistinProje.Data;

namespace FilistinProje.Web.Controllers
