            <script>
                function quickAddToCart(urunId, secenekId) {
                    const token = document.querySelector('input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]')?.value || '';
                    const params = new URLSearchParams();
                    params.append('UrunId', urunId);
                    if (secenekId) params.append('SecenekId', secenekId);
                    params.append('Adet', '1');
                    
                    fetch('/cart/Ekle?' + params.toString(), {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {
                            'RequestVerificationToken': token
                        }
                    })
                    .then(response => response.json())
                    .then(data => {
                        if (data.success) {
                            if (window.showToast) {
                                window.showToast('@Localizer["ProductAdded"]', 'success');
                            }
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                window.location.reload();
                            }, 800);
                        } else {
                            if (window.showToast) {
                                window.showToast(data.message || '@Localizer["ProductAddFailed"]', 'error');
                            } else {
                                alert(data.message || '@Localizer["ProductAddFailed"]');
                            }
                        }
                    })
                    .catch(err => {
                        console.error(err);
                        if (window.showToast) {
                            window.showToast('@Localizer["ConnectionErrorOccurred"]', 'error');
                        } else {
                            alert('@Localizer["ConnectionError"]');
                        }
                    });
                }
            </script>

@inject FilistinProje.Web.Services.IHeaderCategoryService HeaderCategoryService

@inject Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration Configuration
@{
    var userId = UserManager.GetUserId(User);
    var sessionId = HttpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.Session.Id ?? string.Empty;
    var sepetCount = await SepetService.GetSepetUrunSayisiAsync(userId, sessionId);
    var siteSettings = SiteSettingsService.GetSettings();
    var brandName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(siteSettings.MarkaAdi) ? siteSettings.SiteAdi : siteSettings.MarkaAdi;
    var logoUrl = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(siteSettings.SiteLogoUrl) ? "/74anrps48logo2.svg" : siteSettings.SiteLogoUrl;
    var currentCulture = CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture.TwoLetterISOLanguageName;
    var currentPath = HttpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.Request.Path.Value ?? "/";
    var currentQuery = HttpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.Request.QueryString.Value ?? string.Empty;
    var languageReturnUrl = $"{currentPath}{currentQuery}";
    var encodedLanguageReturnUrl = Uri.EscapeDataString(languageReturnUrl);
    var arActive = currentCulture == "ar";
    var enActive = currentCulture == "en";

    var freeShippingLimitText = siteSettings.UcretsizKargoLimiti == decimal.Truncate(siteSettings.UcretsizKargoLimiti)
        ? siteSettings.UcretsizKargoLimiti.ToString("N0")
        : siteSettings.UcretsizKargoLimiti.ToString("N2");
    var topBarPrimary = string.Format(Localizer["FreeShippingLimit"], freeShippingLimitText, siteSettings.ParaBirimi);
    var trustMessages = new List<string>
    {
        topBarPrimary,
        Localizer["BankTransferFooter"],
        Localizer["CashOnDeliveryFooter"],
        Localizer["FastProduction"],
        Localizer["CarefulPackaging"],
        Localizer["PalestineWideShipping"],
        string.Format(Localizer["EasyReturnDays"], siteSettings.IadeHakkiGun),
        Localizer["ManufacturerGuarantee"]
    };

    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(siteSettings.WhatsappNumarasi))
    {
        trustMessages.Add(Localizer["WhatsAppSupport"]);
    }

    trustMessages = trustMessages
        .Where(message => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message))
        .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        .ToList();

    var tumKategoriler = await HeaderCategoryService.GetCategoriesAsync();

    string? GetCategoryMenuImage(Kategori category)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(category.MenuGorselUrl))
        {
            return category.MenuGorselUrl;
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(category.GorselUrl))
        {
            return category.GorselUrl;
        }

        return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(category.BannerUrl) ? category.BannerUrl : null;
    }
}

@using FilistinProje.Web.Extensions
@using System.Globalization
@inject Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.IHttpContextAccessor HttpContextAccessor
@inject FilistinProje.Service.Services.ISiteSettingsService SiteSettingsService
@inject IStringLocalizer<SharedResource> Localizer
@inject Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration Configuration
@inject FilistinProje.Core.Interfaces.ISepetService SepetService
@inject Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.IHttpContextAccessor HttpContextAccessorForCart
@inject UserManager<FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.AppUser> UserManagerForCart
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity
@using FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar
@{
    var siteSettings = SiteSettingsService.GetSettings();
    var _cartUserId = UserManagerForCart.GetUserId(User);
    var _cartSessionId = HttpContextAccessorForCart.HttpContext?.Features.Get<Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Features.ISessionFeature>()?.Session?.Id ?? string.Empty;
    var sepetCount = await SepetService.GetSepetUrunSayisiAsync(_cartUserId, _cartSessionId);
    var brandName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(siteSettings.MarkaAdi) ? siteSettings.SiteAdi : siteSettings.MarkaAdi;
    var pageTitle = ViewData["Title"]?.ToString();
    var seoTitle = ViewData["SeoTitle"]?.ToString();
    var layoutTitle = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(seoTitle)
        ? seoTitle
        : (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(pageTitle) ? brandName : $"{pageTitle} - {brandName}");
    var metaDescription = ViewData["MetaDescription"]?.ToString();
    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(metaDescription))
    {
        metaDescription = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(siteSettings.MetaDescription)
            ? (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(siteSettings.SiteAciklamasi) ? "منتجات ديكور احترافية متميزة." : siteSettings.SiteAciklamasi)
            : siteSettings.MetaDescription;
    }
    var metaKeywords = ViewData["MetaKeywords"]?.ToString();
    var logoUrl = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(siteSettings.SiteLogoUrl) ? "/74anrps48logo2.svg" : siteSettings.SiteLogoUrl;
    var touchIconUrl = "/favicon.svg";
    var faviconUrl = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(siteSettings.FaviconUrl) ? "/favicon.svg" : siteSettings.FaviconUrl;
    var viewOgImage = ViewData["OgImage"]?.ToString();
    var ogImage = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(viewOgImage)
        ? SiteSettingsService.BuildAbsoluteUrl(viewOgImage)
        : (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(siteSettings.VarsayilanSosyalPaylasimGorseliUrl)
            ? SiteSettingsService.BuildAbsoluteUrl(logoUrl)
            : SiteSettingsService.BuildAbsoluteUrl(siteSettings.VarsayilanSosyalPaylasimGorseliUrl));
    var currentPath = HttpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.Request.Path.Value ?? "/";
    var currentQuery = HttpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.Request.QueryString.Value ?? string.Empty;
    var currentUrl = SiteSettingsService.BuildAbsoluteUrl($"{currentPath}{currentQuery}");
    var currentCulture = CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture.TwoLetterISOLanguageName;
    var currentDirection = currentCulture == "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr";
    var canonicalUrl = ViewData["CanonicalUrl"]?.ToString();

    canonicalUrl = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(canonicalUrl)
        ? currentUrl
        : SiteSettingsService.BuildAbsoluteUrl(canonicalUrl);
    var ogType = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ViewData["OgType"]?.ToString()) ? "website" : ViewData["OgType"]!.ToString();
}

        window.toggleMobileNav = function(open) {
            const drawer = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
            const backdrop = document.getElementById('mobileNavBackdrop');
            const button = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
            if (!drawer || !backdrop) return;

            const shouldOpen = typeof open === 'boolean' ? open : drawer.classList.contains('hidden');
            if (shouldOpen) {
                drawer.classList.remove('hidden');
                backdrop.classList.remove('hidden');
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    drawer.classList.add('is-open');
                    backdrop.classList.add('is-open');
                });
                if (button) button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
                const firstFocusable = drawer.querySelector('a, button, input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])');
                if (firstFocusable) setTimeout(() => firstFocusable.focus(), 100);
            } else {
                drawer.classList.remove('is-open');
                backdrop.classList.remove('is-open');
                if (button) button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    drawer.classList.add('hidden');
                    backdrop.classList.add('hidden');
                }, 430);
                if (button) button.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }
            document.documentElement.classList.toggle('overflow-hidden', shouldOpen);
            document.body.classList.toggle('overflow-hidden', shouldOpen);
        };

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
            if (!mobileNav || mobileNav.classList.contains('hidden')) return;

            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                e.preventDefault();
                window.toggleMobileNav(false);
                return;
            }

            if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
            const focusable = Array.from(mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a, button, input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'))
                .filter(el => !el.disabled && el.offsetParent !== null);
            if (focusable.length === 0) return;

            const first = focusable[0];
            const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
            if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
                e.preventDefault();
                last.focus();
            } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
                e.preventDefault();
                first.focus();
            }
        });

                dpopover.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        });

function alignCategoryDropdown(menuItem) {
                const dropdown = menuItem.querySelector('[data-category-dropdown]');

                const boundedLeft = Math.min(

                        window.showToast(responseMessage, 'error');

        window.formatMoney = function(amount, culture) {
            if (typeof amount !== 'number' || !isFinite(amount)) return '\u20AA' + amount;
            const lang = culture || document.documentElement.lang || 'ar';
            const locale = lang === 'ar' ? 'ar-PS' : 'en-IL';
            const currency = 'ILS';
            try {
                return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
                    style: 'currency',
                    currency: currency,
                    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
                    maximumFractionDigits: 2
                }).format(amount).replace(/[\s]*ILS/i, '').trim();
            } catch (e) {
                return '\u20AA' + amount.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
            }
        };

        window.showToast = function(message, type = 'success') {
            const container = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
            if (!container) return;

            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = 'transform translate-y-10 opacity-0 transition-all duration-500 ease-out flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-4 rounded shadow-lg backdrop-blur-md min-w-[300px] border-l-4';
            
            let iconHtml = '';
            const decoder = document.createElement('textarea');
            decoder.innerHTML = String(message || '');
            const safeMessage = decoder.value.replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(char) {
                return ({
                    '&': '&amp;',
                    '<': '&lt;',
                    '>': '&gt;',
                    '"': '&quot;',
                    "'": '&#39;'
                })[char];
            });

            if (type === 'success') {
                toast.classList.add('bg-brand-cream', 'bg-opacity-95', 'text-brand-olive', 'border-brand-olive');
                iconHtml = '<i class="fas fa-check-circle text-xl text-brand-olive"></i>';
            } else if (type === 'error') {
                toast.classList.add('bg-white', 'bg-opacity-95', 'text-red-800', 'border-red-600');
                iconHtml = '<i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle text-xl text-red-600"></i>';
            } else {
                toast.classList.add('bg-white', 'bg-opacity-95', 'text-blue-800', 'border-blue-600');
                iconHtml = '<i class="fas fa-info-circle text-xl text-blue-600"></i>';
            }

            toast.innerHTML = `
                ${iconHtml}
                <div class="flex-1">
                    <p class="font-medium text-sm tracking-wide font-sans">${safeMessage}</p>
                </div>
                <button onclick="this.parentElement.remove()" class="text-gray-400 hover:text-brand-olive transition-colors ml-4">
                    <i class="fas fa-times"></i>
                </button>
            `;

            container.appendChild(toast);

            // Trigger animation
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    toast.classList.remove('translate-y-10', 'opacity-0');
                    toast.classList.add('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');
                });
            });

            // Auto remove
            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.remove('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');
                toast.classList.add('translate-y-10', 'opacity-0');
                setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 500);
            }, 4000);
        };

        // ─── AJAX Sepete Ekleme Sistemi (Event Delegation) ───
        const quickAddAddingText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["AddingToCart"].Value));
        const quickAddAddedText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["AddedToCart"].Value));
        const quickAddCartErrorText = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["CartError"].Value));

        document.body.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            const btn = e.target.closest('.js-quick-add-btn');
            if (!btn) return;
            e.preventDefault();

            if (btn.disabled) return;

            const urunId = btn.getAttribute('data-urun-id');
            if (!urunId) return;

            const icon = btn.querySelector('.js-quick-add-icon');
            const label = btn.querySelector('.js-quick-add-label');

            const originalIconClass = icon ? icon.className : '';
            const originalLabelText = label ? label.textContent : '';

            // Loading state
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.classList.add('cursor-wait', 'opacity-80');
            if (icon) icon.className = 'fas fa-spinner fa-spin text-xs';
            if (label) label.textContent = quickAddAddingText;

            // Anti-forgery token
            const tokenForm = document.getElementById('globalAntiForgeryForm');
            const tokenInput = tokenForm ? tokenForm.querySelector('input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]') : null;
            const token = tokenInput ? tokenInput.value : '';

            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('UrunId', urunId);
            formData.append('Adet', '1');
            if (token) {
                formData.append('__RequestVerificationToken', token);
            }

            fetch('/cart/Ekle', {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: {
                    'RequestVerificationToken': token
                }
            })
            .then(response => response.json())
            .then(data => {
                if (data.success) {
                    if (icon) icon.className = 'fas fa-check text-xs';
                    if (label) label.textContent = quickAddAddedText;
                    window.showToast(quickAddAddedText, 'success');

                    // Sepet sayısını güncelle
                    fetch('/cart/count')
                    .then(r => r.json())
                    .then(countData => {
                        const newCount = countData.count;

                        // Sayaçları güncelle
                        const cartCountEl = document.getElementById('cartItemCount');
                        const cartCountMobileEl = document.getElementById('cartItemCountMobile');
                        const floatingCartEl = document.querySelector('.floating-cart-btn');

                        if (cartCountEl) {
                            cartCountEl.textContent = newCount;
                            cartCountEl.classList.remove('scale-0');
                            cartCountEl.classList.add('scale-110');
                            setTimeout(() => cartCountEl.classList.remove('scale-110'), 250);
                        }
                        if (cartCountMobileEl) {
                            cartCountMobileEl.textContent = newCount;
                        }

                        // Floating sepet sayacı
                        if (floatingCartEl) {
                            let floatBadge = floatingCartEl.querySelector('span');
                            if (newCount > 0) {
                                if (!floatBadge) {
                                    floatBadge = document.createElement('span');
                                    floatBadge.className = 'absolute -top-1 -end-1 bg-brand-gold text-white text-[10px] w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold shadow-md';
                                    floatingCartEl.appendChild(floatBadge);
                                }
                                floatBadge.textContent = newCount;
                            } else if (floatBadge) {
                                floatBadge.remove();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                } else {
                    window.showToast(data.message || quickAddCartErrorText, 'error');
                }
            })
            .catch(error => {
                console.error('Cart error:', error);
                window.showToast(quickAddCartErrorText, 'error');
            })
            .finally(() => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.classList.remove('cursor-wait', 'opacity-80');
                    if (icon) icon.className = originalIconClass;
                    if (label) label.textContent = originalLabelText;
                }, 1200);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        window.toggleSearchBar = function(open) {
            const mobileBar = document.getElementById('mobileSearchBar');
            const desktopBar = document.getElementById('desktopSearchBar');
            const logo = document.getElementById('siteLogo');
            const nav = document.querySelector('nav');
            const mobileMenuBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
            const mobileSearchBtn = document.getElementById('mobileSearchBtn');
            const mobileIcons = document.getElementById('mobileIcons');
            const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
            const mobileBackdrop = document.getElementById('mobileNavBackdrop');
            const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 768;

            if (mobileNav && !mobileNav.classList.contains('hidden')) window.toggleMobileNav(false);

            let shouldOpen;
            if (typeof open === 'boolean') {
                shouldOpen = open;
            } else {
                shouldOpen = isMobile
                    ? mobileBar.style.display !== 'flex'
                    : desktopBar.classList.contains('hidden') || desktopBar.style.display !== 'flex';
            }

            if (isMobile) {
                if (shouldOpen) {
                    mobileBar.style.display = 'flex';
                    mobileBar.classList.remove('hidden');
                    const msb = document.getElementById('mobileSearchBtn');
                    if (msb) msb.style.display = 'none';
                    setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('mobileSearchInput')?.focus(), 50);
                } else {
                    mobileBar.style.display = 'none';
                    mobileBar.classList.add('hidden');
                    const msb = document.getElementById('mobileSearchBtn');
                    if (msb) msb.style.display = 'inline-flex';
                    const inp = document.getElementById('mobileSearchInput');
                    if (inp) inp.value = '';
                    document.getElementById('searchResultsDropdown')?.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            } else {
                if (shouldOpen) {
                    desktopBar.style.display = 'flex';
                    desktopBar.classList.remove('hidden');
                    const dsb = document.getElementById('desktopSearchBtn');
                    if (dsb) dsb.style.display = 'none';
                    setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('desktopSearchInput')?.focus(), 50);
                } else {
                    desktopBar.style.display = 'none';
                    desktopBar.classList.add('hidden');
                    const dsb = document.getElementById('desktopSearchBtn');
                    if (dsb) dsb.style.display = 'block';
                    const inp = document.getElementById('desktopSearchInput');
                    if (inp) inp.value = '';
                    document.getElementById('searchResultsDropdown')?.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            }
        };

        (function () {
            const desktopInput = document.getElementById('desktopSearchInput');
            const mobileInput = document.getElementById('mobileSearchInput');
            const resultsDropdown = document.getElementById('searchResultsDropdown');
            let searchTimer = null, abortController = null;
            let selectedIndex = -1;
            let currentResults = [];

            /* ---- helpers ---- */

            function escapeHtml(value) {
                return String(value || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
            }

            function getActiveInput() {
                return window.innerWidth < 768 ? mobileInput : desktopInput;
            }

            function positionDropdown() {
                if (!resultsDropdown || resultsDropdown.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
                const input = getActiveInput();
                if (!input) return;
                const rect = input.getBoundingClientRect();
                const scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
                const width = Math.max(rect.width, 300);
                resultsDropdown.style.width = width + 'px';
                if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
                    resultsDropdown.style.top = (rect.bottom + scrollTop + 6) + 'px';
                    resultsDropdown.style.left = '16px';
                    resultsDropdown.style.right = '16px';
                    resultsDropdown.style.minWidth = 'unset';
                } else {
                    resultsDropdown.style.top = (rect.bottom + scrollTop + 8) + 'px';
                    resultsDropdown.style.left = Math.max(rect.left, 8) + 'px';
                    resultsDropdown.style.right = 'auto';
                    resultsDropdown.style.minWidth = '340px';
                    resultsDropdown.style.maxWidth = Math.min(500, window.innerWidth - 32) + 'px';
                }
            }

            /* ---- render helpers ---- */

            function renderItemsHtml(items) {
                return items.slice(0, 8).map((item, idx) => {
                    const title = escapeHtml(item.baslik || '');
                    const brand = item.marka ? escapeHtml(item.marka) : '';
                    const category = item.kategori ? escapeHtml(item.kategori) : '';
                    const price = item.fiyat ? escapeHtml(item.fiyat) : '';
                    const image = item.gorsel ? `<img src="${escapeHtml(item.gorsel)}" alt="${title}" class="w-12 h-12 object-cover rounded" loading="lazy" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.parentElement.querySelector('.search-img-fallback').style.display='flex'">` : '';
                    const fallbackIcon = `<div class="w-12 h-12 rounded flex items-center justify-center search-img-fallback" style="${image ? 'display:none' : 'display:flex'}"><i class="fas fa-image text-brand-gold"></i></div>`;
                    const url = item.slug ? '/products/' + encodeURIComponent(item.slug) + '-' + item.id : '/products/' + item.id;
                    let metaHtml = '';
                    if (brand) metaHtml += `<span class="text-[11px] text-brand-mutedtext px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-brand-border">${brand}</span>`;
                    if (category) metaHtml += `<span class="text-[11px] text-brand-mutedtext px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-brand-border">${category}</span>`;
                    return `<a href="${url}" class="search-result-item flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg transition-colors hover:bg-brand-warmcream group" data-index="${idx}" role="option" aria-selected="false">
                        ${image}${fallbackIcon}
                        <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                            <div class="text-sm font-medium text-brand-darktext truncate group-hover:text-brand-gold transition-colors">${title}</div>
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                                ${price ? `<div class="text-xs text-brand-gold font-semibold">${price}</div>` : ''}
                                ${metaHtml}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <i class="fas fa-arrow-right text-[10px] text-brand-gold opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"></i>
                    </a>`;
                }).join('');
            }

            function renderDropdown(data) {
                const items = data && data.items ? data.items : (Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
                const total = data && typeof data.total === 'number' ? data.total : items.length;
                currentResults = items;
                selectedIndex = -1;
                if (!items || items.length === 0) {
                    showResults('<div class="px-4 py-5 text-center text-sm text-brand-mutedtext"><i class="fas fa-search mr-1"></i>@Localizer["NoResultsFound"]</div>');
                    return;
                }
                const term = (getActiveInput()?.value || '').trim();
                const resultCountLabel = '<div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-brand-mutedtext px-2 pb-2">' + total + ' @Localizer["ResultsFound"]</div>';
                const itemsHtml = renderItemsHtml(items);
                const footer = total > 8
                    ? `<a href="/products?s=${encodeURIComponent(term)}" class="block text-center text-xs text-brand-gold font-semibold py-2.5 border-t border-brand-border hover:bg-brand-warmcream transition-colors rounded-b-lg" role="option">@Localizer["ViewAllResults"] <i class="fas fa-arrow-right ml-1 text-[10px]"></i></a>`
                    : '';
                showResults('<div class="p-2" role="listbox" aria-label="@Localizer["SearchResults"]">' + resultCountLabel + itemsHtml + footer + '</div>');
                if (resultsDropdown) resultsDropdown.scrollTop = 0;
            }

            function showLoading() {
                if (!resultsDropdown) return;
                resultsDropdown.innerHTML = '<div class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-sm text-brand-mutedtext"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin mr-2"></i>@Localizer["Searching"]</div>';
                resultsDropdown.classList.remove('hidden');
                positionDropdown();
            }

            function showResults(html) {
                if (!resultsDropdown) return;
                resultsDropdown.innerHTML = html;
                resultsDropdown.classList.remove('hidden');
                positionDropdown();
            }

            function hideResults() {
                resultsDropdown?.classList.add('hidden');
                currentResults = [];
                selectedIndex = -1;
            }

            /* ---- keyboard navigation ---- */

            function getResultLinks() {
                if (!resultsDropdown || resultsDropdown.classList.contains('hidden')) return [];
                return Array.from(resultsDropdown.querySelectorAll('.search-result-item'));
            }

            function updateSelection() {
                const links = getResultLinks();
                links.forEach((link, i) => {
                    link.classList.toggle('bg-brand-warmcream', i === selectedIndex);
                    link.setAttribute('aria-selected', i === selectedIndex ? 'true' : 'false');
                });
                if (selectedIndex >= 0 && links[selectedIndex]) {
                    links[selectedIndex].scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
                }
            }

            function navigateSelection(direction) {
                const links = getResultLinks();
                if (links.length === 0) return;
                selectedIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(links.length - 1, selectedIndex + direction));
                updateSelection();
            }

            function commitSelection() {
                const links = getResultLinks();
                if (selectedIndex >= 0 && selectedIndex < links.length) {
                    window.location.href = links[selectedIndex].href;
                    return true;
                }
                // No selection â€” submit the form to go to search results page
                return false;
            }

            /* ---- fetch ---- */

            function runSearch(term) {
                if (term.length < 2) { hideResults(); return; }
                if (abortController) abortController.abort();
                abortController = new AbortController();
                showLoading();
                fetch('/products/CanliAra?q=' + encodeURIComponent(term), { signal: abortController.signal })
                    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null)
                    .then(data => { renderDropdown(data); })
                    .catch(error => {
                        if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {
                            showResults('<div class="px-4 py-5 text-center text-sm text-red-600"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle mr-1"></i>@Localizer["SearchUnavailable"]</div>');
                        }
                    });
            }

            /* ---- event bindings ---- */

            [desktopInput, mobileInput].forEach(input => {
                if (!input) return;

                input.addEventListener('input', function () {
                    clearTimeout(searchTimer);
                    const term = this.value.trim();
                    if (term.length < 2) { hideResults(); return; }
                    searchTimer = setTimeout(() => runSearch(term), 220);
                });

                input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        if (resultsDropdown?.classList.contains('hidden') && this.value.trim().length >= 2) {
                            runSearch(this.value.trim());
                        } else {
                            navigateSelection(1);
                        }
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        navigateSelection(-1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                        if (!resultsDropdown?.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                            const committed = commitSelection();
                            if (committed) { e.preventDefault(); return; }
                        }
                        // fall through to default form submit
                    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                        hideResults();
                    }
                });

                input.setAttribute('aria-autocomplete', 'list');
                input.setAttribute('aria-controls', 'searchResultsDropdown');
                input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                input.setAttribute('role', 'combobox');
            });

            /* ---- global close/resize ---- */

            document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                if (!resultsDropdown?.contains(e.target) &&
                    !e.target.closest('#desktopSearchInput') &&
                    !e.target.closest('#mobileSearchInput')) {
                    hideResults();
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape') { hideResults(); window.toggleSearchBar(false); }
            });

            window.addEventListener('resize', positionDropdown);
            window.addEventListener('scroll', positionDropdown, true);

            /* update aria-expanded on dropdown toggle */
            const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
                const input = getActiveInput();
                if (input) {
                    input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', resultsDropdown?.classList.contains('hidden') ? 'false' : 'true');
                }
            });
            if (resultsDropdown) observer.observe(resultsDropdown, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
        })();
    </script>

<script>
        window.toggleFavori = function(btn, urunId) {
            const evt = window.event;
            if (evt) {
                evt.preventDefault();
                evt.stopPropagation();
            }

            const originalHtml = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin text-sm text-brand-mutedtext"></i>';
            btn.disabled = true;

            let token = document.querySelector('#globalAntiForgeryForm input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]')?.value;

            fetch('/favorites/Toggle?urunId=' + urunId, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'RequestVerificationToken': token || ''
                }
            })
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                if(data.success) {
                    if(data.isAdded) {
                        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-heart text-sm text-red-500 drop-shadow-sm"></i>';
                        if(window.showToast) window.showToast('@Localizer["ProductAddedToFavorites"]', 'success');
                    } else {
                        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="far fa-heart text-sm text-[#4a4a4a] group-hover/btn:text-red-400 transition-colors"></i>';
                        if(window.showToast) window.showToast('@Localizer["ProductRemovedFromFavorites"]', 'info');
                    }
                } else {
                    if (data.message === '@Localizer["PleaseLogin"]') {
                        window.location.href = '/account/GirisYap?ReturnUrl=' + window.location.pathname;
                    } else {
                        if(window.showToast) window.showToast(data.message || '@Localizer["AnErrorOccurred"]', 'error');
                        btn.innerHTML = originalHtml;
                    }
                }
            })
            .catch(err => {
                console.error(err);
                if(window.showToast) window.showToast('@Localizer["ConnectionError"]', 'error');
                btn.innerHTML = originalHtml;
            })
            .finally(() => {
                btn.disabled = false;
            });
        };
    </script>

    @await Html.PartialAsync("_FloatingButtons")

    <!-- Spin the Wheel -->
</body>
</html>

@model FilistinProje.Web.Models.ProductCardViewModel
@inject FilistinProje.Service.Services.ISiteSettingsService SiteSettingsService
@inject IStringLocalizer<SharedResource> Localizer

@{
    var siteSettings = SiteSettingsService.GetSettings();
    var stoktaYokSatisIzni = siteSettings.StoktaYokSatisIzni;
    var currencySymbol = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(siteSettings.ParaBirimi) ? "₪" : siteSettings.ParaBirimi;

    var urlSlug = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.Slug)
        ? Model.Slug
        : FilistinProje.Core.Helpers.SlugHelper.GenerateSlug(Model.Baslik);
    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(urlSlug))
    {
        urlSlug = "urun";
    }

    var urunUrl = $"/products/{urlSlug}-{Model.Id}";

    // Fiyat mantığı
    decimal gosterFiyat;
    decimal? eskiFiyat = null;
    if (Model.IsWholesale && Model.TopFiyat.HasValue && Model.TopFiyat.Value > 0)
    {
        gosterFiyat = Model.TopFiyat.Value;
        eskiFiyat = Model.Fiyat > gosterFiyat ? Model.Fiyat : null;
    }
    else if (Model.IndirimVarMi && Model.IndirimliFiyat.HasValue)
    {
        gosterFiyat = Model.IndirimliFiyat.Value;
        eskiFiyat = Model.Fiyat;
    }
    else
    {
        gosterFiyat = Model.Fiyat;
    }

    bool satisaAcik = stoktaYokSatisIzni || Model.StoktaVarMi;
    bool azStok = Model.StoktaVarMi && Model.ToplamStok >= 1 && Model.ToplamStok <= 4;

    // Rozet önceliği: stok yok > az stok > özel > indirim > yeni
    string? badgeBg = null;
    string? badgeText = null;
    if (!stoktaYokSatisIzni && !Model.StoktaVarMi)
    {
        badgeBg = "bg-gray-400";
        badgeText = Localizer["OutOfStock"].Value;
    }
    else if (azStok)
    {
        badgeBg = "bg-red-500";
        badgeText = string.Format(Localizer["LowStockBadge"].Value ?? "Son {0}", Model.ToplamStok);
    }
    else if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.BadgeText))
    {
        badgeBg = "bg-brand-olive";
        badgeText = Model.BadgeText;
    }
    else if (Model.IndirimVarMi)
    {
        badgeBg = "bg-brand-gold";
        badgeText = "%" + Model.IndirimYuzdesi;
    }
    else if (Model.YeniUrunMu)
    {
        badgeBg = "bg-brand-olive";
        badgeText = Localizer["New"].Value;
    }

    bool kampanyaAktif = Model.KampanyaBitisTarihi.HasValue && Model.KampanyaBitisTarihi.Value > DateTime.UtcNow;
}

        @* Hover Overlay — Hızlı Ekle + Hızlı Bakış *@
        <div class="absolute inset-0 z-20
                    flex flex-col items-center justify-end pb-3 gap-2
                    bg-gradient-to-t from-black/45 via-black/10 to-transparent
                    opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100
                    pointer-events-none group-hover:pointer-events-auto
                    transition-opacity duration-200">

            @if (Model.ShowQuickAdd && satisaAcik && !Model.FiyatGizliMi)
            {
                <button type="button"
                        data-urun-id="@Model.Id"
                        data-action="quick-add"
                        aria-label="@Localizer["AddToCart"]"
                        class="js-quick-add-btn
                               inline-flex items-center gap-2
                               bg-brand-olive hover:bg-[#1c2001] active:scale-95
                               text-white text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide
                               px-4 py-2 rounded-full shadow-lg
                               transition-all duration-200
                               focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-gold focus-visible:ring-offset-1">
                    <i class="fas fa-cart-plus text-xs js-quick-add-icon"></i>
                    <span class="js-quick-add-label">@Localizer["AddToCart"]</span>
                </button>
            }

            <a href="@urunUrl"
               class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5

========== FilistinProje.Web\Views\Siparis\_OrderSummary.cshtml ==========
@model FilistinProje.Core.DTOs.CheckoutRequestDto
@using FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar
@inject FilistinProje.Service.Services.ISiteSettingsService SiteSettingsService
@inject IStringLocalizer<SharedResource> Localizer
@{
    var currencySymbol = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SiteSettingsService.GetSettings().ParaBirimi) ? "₪" : SiteSettingsService.GetSettings().ParaBirimi;
    decimal araToplam = ViewBag.AraToplam ?? 0;
    decimal indirim = ViewBag.IndirimTutari ?? 0;
    decimal genelToplam = ViewBag.ToplamTutar ?? 0;
    string? kuponKodu = ViewBag.KuponKodu as string;
    var sepetItems = ViewBag.SepetItems as List<FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.SepetItem> ?? new List<FilistinProje.Core.Varliklar.SepetItem>();
    decimal ucretsizKargoLimiti = (decimal)(ViewBag.UcretsizKargoLimiti ?? 500);
    decimal codBedel = (decimal)(ViewBag.KapidaOdemeHizmetBedeli ?? 0);
    decimal indirimliToplam = araToplam - indirim;
    decimal kalanTutar = Math.Max(0, ucretsizKargoLimiti - indirimliToplam);
    int shippingProgress = ucretsizKargoLimiti > 0 ? Math.Min(100, (int)(indirimliToplam / ucretsizKargoLimiti * 100)) : 100;
}

<div class="checkout-summary-card">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-brand-border pb-5">
        <h2 class="font-serif text-2xl text-brand-olive">@Localizer["OrderSummary"]</h2>
        <a href="/cart" class="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-brand-gold hover:text-brand-olive">@Localizer["Checkout_EditCart"]</a>
    </div>

    <div class="max-h-[310px] space-y-4 overflow-y-auto py-5 pe-1">
        @foreach (var item in sepetItems)
        {
            <div class="flex gap-3">
                <div class="relative h-16 w-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-brand-cream"><img src="@item.UrunResimUrl" alt="@item.UrunBaslik" class="h-full w-full object-cover" loading="lazy"><span class="absolute end-1 top-1 flex h-5 min-w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-brand-olive px-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-white">@item.Adet</span></div>
                <div class="min-w-0 flex-1"><h3 class="line-clamp-2 text-xs font-semibold leading-relaxed text-brand-darktext">@item.UrunBaslik</h3>@if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.SecenekAdi)) { <p class="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-brand-mutedtext">@item.SecenekAdi</p> }<p class="mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-olive">@item.Toplam.ToString("N2") @currencySymbol</p></div>
            </div>
        }
    </div>

    <div id="checkoutFreeShippingBanner" class="mb-5 rounded-xl border p-4 @(kalanTutar > 0 ? "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50" : "border-green-200 bg-green-50")">
        @if (kalanTutar > 0)
        {
            <div class="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-amber-800"><i class="fas fa-truck-fast text-brand-gold"></i><span>@Localizer["FreeShippingNotice", currencySymbol + kalanTutar.ToString("N2")]</span></div><div class="h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-amber-200"><div class="h-full rounded-full bg-brand-gold transition-all" style="width:@shippingProgress%"></div></div>
        }
        else
        {
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-green-800"><i class="fas fa-circle-check"></i>@Localizer["FreeShippingReached"]</div>
        }

@functions {
    string FormatIban(string iban)
    {
        var clean = (iban ?? string.Empty).Replace(" ", "");
        return string.Join(" ", Enumerable.Range(0, (clean.Length + 3) / 4).Select(i => clean.Substring(i * 4, Math.Min(4, clean.Length - i * 4))));
    }
}

<script>
    const checkoutUploadToken = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(ViewBag.CheckoutUploadToken as string ?? string.Empty));
    const currencySymbol = @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(currencySymbol));

    function formatCheckoutNumber(amount) {
        return Number(amount).toLocaleString(document.documentElement.lang === 'ar' ? 'ar-PS' : 'en-US', {
            minimumFractionDigits: 2,
            maximumFractionDigits: 2
        });
    }
    function selectAddress(ad, tel, sehir, ilce, acikAdres) {
        document.getElementById("MusteriAdSoyad").value = ad;
        document.getElementById("Telefon").value = tel;
        document.getElementById("Sehir").value = sehir;
        document.getElementById("Ilce").value = ilce;
        document.getElementById("AcikAdres").value = acikAdres;

        if (window.showToast) {
            window.showToast('@Localizer["AddressLoaded"]', 'success');
        }
    }

    function handleReceteFileUpload(input) {
        if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
            var file = input.files[0];

            if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
                if (window.showToast) {
                    window.showToast('@Localizer["Siparis_FileUploadError"]', 'error');
                }
                return;
            }

            var reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function(e) {
                var preview = document.getElementById('recetePreview');
                var pdfPlaceholder = document.getElementById('recetePdfPlaceholder');
                var container = document.getElementById('recetePreviewContainer');

                if (file.type === 'application/pdf') {
                    if (preview) preview.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (pdfPlaceholder) {
                        pdfPlaceholder.classList.remove('hidden');
                        var nameEl = document.getElementById('recetePdfName');
                        if (nameEl) nameEl.textContent = file.name;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (pdfPlaceholder) pdfPlaceholder.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (preview) {
                        preview.src = e.target.result;
                        preview.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }
                }
                if (container) container.classList.remove('hidden');
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);

            uploadRecetePhoto(file, file.name);
        }
    }

    function uploadRecetePhoto(file, filename) {
        var formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('dosya', file, filename);

        var token = document.querySelector('input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]').value;

        var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhr.open('POST', '/checkout/YukleRecete', true);
        xhr.setRequestHeader('RequestVerificationToken', token);
        xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Checkout-Upload-Token', checkoutUploadToken);

        xhr.onload = function() {
            if (xhr.status === 200) {
                try {
                    var response = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                    if (response.success) {
                        document.getElementById('ReceteDosyaYolu').value = response.url;
                        if (window.showToast) {
                            window.showToast('@Localizer["PrescriptionUploaded"]', 'success');
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (window.showToast) {
                            window.showToast(response.message || 'Hata oluştu', 'error');
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    if (window.showToast) {
                        window.showToast('@Localizer["Siparis_FileUploadError"]', 'error');
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if (window.showToast) {
                    window.showToast('@Localizer["Siparis_FileUploadError"]', 'error');
                }
            }
        };

        xhr.send(formData);
    }

    function toggleDeliveryType() {
        var isStorePickup = document.querySelector('input[name="TeslimatTipi"]:checked')?.value === 'MagazadanTeslim';
        var adresAlanlari = document.getElementById('adresAlanlari');
        var shippingAddressFields = [
            document.getElementById('adresSehirAlani'),
            document.getElementById('adresIlceAlani'),
            document.getElementById('adresAcikAdresAlani'),
            document.getElementById('adresKaydetAlani')
        ];
        var requiredShippingInputs = [
            document.getElementById('Sehir'),
            document.getElementById('Ilce'),
            document.getElementById('AcikAdres')
        ];
        var kargoAlanlari = document.getElementById('kargoAlanlari');
        var storePickupInfo = document.getElementById('storePickupInfo');
        var checkoutKargoSatiri = document.getElementById('checkoutKargoSatiri');
        var checkoutFreeShippingBanner = document.getElementById('checkoutFreeShippingBanner');
        var checkoutKargoDisplay = document.getElementById('checkoutKargoUcreti');
        var checkoutCodSurchargeSatiri = document.getElementById('checkoutCodSurchargeSatiri');
        var totalDisplay = document.getElementById('checkoutGenelToplam');
        var btnTotalDisplay = document.getElementById('checkoutBtnTotal');
        var codPaymentOption = document.getElementById('codPaymentOption');

        if (isStorePickup) {
            if (adresAlanlari) adresAlanlari.classList.remove('hidden');
            shippingAddressFields.forEach(function(field) { if (field) field.classList.add('hidden'); });
            requiredShippingInputs.forEach(function(input) { if (input) input.required = false; });
            if (kargoAlanlari) kargoAlanlari.classList.add('hidden');
            if (storePickupInfo) storePickupInfo.classList.remove('hidden');
            if (checkoutKargoSatiri) checkoutKargoSatiri.classList.add('hidden');
            if (checkoutCodSurchargeSatiri) checkoutCodSurchargeSatiri.classList.add('hidden');
            if (checkoutFreeShippingBanner) checkoutFreeShippingBanner.classList.add('hidden');
            if (codPaymentOption) codPaymentOption.classList.remove('hidden');

            var subtotal = parseFloat("@((araToplam - indirim).ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))");
            if (totalDisplay) {
                totalDisplay.innerHTML = formatCheckoutNumber(subtotal) + ' <span class="text-lg font-normal text-brand-mutedtext">' + currencySymbol + '</span>';
            }
            if (btnTotalDisplay) {
                btnTotalDisplay.textContent = formatCheckoutNumber(subtotal);
            }
        } else {
            if (adresAlanlari) adresAlanlari.classList.remove('hidden');
            shippingAddressFields.forEach(function(field) { if (field) field.classList.remove('hidden'); });
            requiredShippingInputs.forEach(function(input) { if (input) input.required = true; });
            if (kargoAlanlari) kargoAlanlari.classList.remove('hidden');
            if (storePickupInfo) storePickupInfo.classList.add('hidden');
            if (checkoutKargoSatiri) checkoutKargoSatiri.classList.remove('hidden');
            var selectedPayment = document.querySelector('input[name="odemeYontemi"]:checked')?.value;
            if (checkoutCodSurchargeSatiri) checkoutCodSurchargeSatiri.classList.toggle('hidden', selectedPayment !== 'KapidaOdeme');
            if (checkoutFreeShippingBanner) checkoutFreeShippingBanner.classList.remove('hidden');
            if (codPaymentOption) codPaymentOption.classList.remove('hidden');
            if (typeof sehirKargoHesapla === 'function') {
                sehirKargoHesapla();
            }
        }

        requiredShippingInputs.forEach(function(input) {
            if (input && typeof clearCheckoutFieldError === 'function') clearCheckoutFieldError(input);
        });
        var clientAlert = document.getElementById('checkoutClientAlert');
        if (clientAlert) clientAlert.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    const checkoutValidationMessages = {
        MusteriAdSoyad: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Siparis_NameRequired"].Value)),
        Eposta: @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Localizer["Siparis_EmailRequired"].Value)),

    function setCheckoutFieldError(fieldName, message) {
        const field = document.getElementById(fieldName) || document.querySelector('[name="' + fieldName + '"]');
        const messageEl = form.querySelector('[data-valmsg-for="' + fieldName + '"]');
        if (field) field.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
        if (messageEl && !messageEl.textContent.trim()) {
            messageEl.textContent = message;
            messageEl.dataset.clientError = 'true';
        }
    }

    function clearCheckoutFieldError(field) {
        field.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
        const fieldName = field.name;
        const messageEl = fieldName ? form.querySelector('[data-valmsg-for="' + fieldName + '"]') : null;
        if (messageEl?.dataset.clientError === 'true') {
            messageEl.textContent = '';
            delete messageEl.dataset.clientError;
        }
    }

    // Form submission validation UI
    const form = document.getElementById('odemeForm');
    form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
        const errors = [];
        let firstInvalidField = null;
        const requiredFields = ['MusteriAdSoyad', 'Eposta', 'Telefon', 'Sehir', 'Ilce', 'AcikAdres'];

        requiredFields.forEach(function(fieldName) {
            const field = document.getElementById(fieldName);
            if (!field || field.disabled || !field.required) return;
            const empty = !field.value.trim();
            const invalidEmail = fieldName === 'Eposta' && !empty && !field.validity.valid;
            const shortAddress = fieldName === 'AcikAdres' && !empty && field.value.trim().length < 10;
            if (empty || invalidEmail || shortAddress) {
                errors.push(checkoutValidationMessages[fieldName]);
                setCheckoutFieldError(fieldName, checkoutValidationMessages[fieldName]);
                firstInvalidField = firstInvalidField || field;
            }
        });

        if (!form.querySelector('input[name="odemeYontemi"]:checked')) {
            errors.push(checkoutValidationMessages.OdemeYontemi);
            setCheckoutFieldError('OdemeYontemi', checkoutValidationMessages.OdemeYontemi);
            firstInvalidField = firstInvalidField || form.querySelector('input[name="odemeYontemi"]');
        }

        const terms = document.getElementById('SozlesmeOnaylandi');
        if (!terms?.checked) {
            errors.push(checkoutValidationMessages.SozlesmeOnaylandi);
            setCheckoutFieldError('SozlesmeOnaylandi', checkoutValidationMessages.SozlesmeOnaylandi);
            firstInvalidField = firstInvalidField || terms;
        }

        const receteZorunlu = @(receteZorunlu ? "true" : "false");
        if (receteZorunlu) {
            const receteYolu = document.getElementById('ReceteDosyaYolu')?.value;
            if (!receteYolu || receteYolu.trim() === '') {
                errors.push(checkoutValidationMessages.ReceteDosyaYolu);
                setCheckoutFieldError('ReceteDosyaYolu', checkoutValidationMessages.ReceteDosyaYolu);
            }
        }

        if (errors.length) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const alert = document.getElementById('checkoutClientAlert');
            const list = document.getElementById('checkoutClientErrors');
            list.replaceChildren(...[...new Set(errors)].map(function(message) {
                const item = document.createElement('li');
                item.textContent = message;
                return item;
            }));
            alert.classList.remove('hidden');
            alert.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
            window.setTimeout(function() { (firstInvalidField || alert).focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 350);
        }
    });

    form.addEventListener('input', function(event) { clearCheckoutFieldError(event.target); });
    form.addEventListener('change', function(event) { clearCheckoutFieldError(event.target); });

                container.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'scale-0');
                container.classList.add('opacity-100', 'scale-100');
            }
        });
    });

    // Identity Photo (WebRTC + Upload)
    var identityStream = null;
    var identityPreviewObjectUrl = null;

    var cameraMessages = (document.documentElement.lang || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('ar')
        ? {
            unsupported: 'الكاميرا غير مدعومة في هذا المتصفح. يرجى رفع ملف بدلاً منها.',

            busy: 'The camera could not be started. Close other apps or upload a file instead.',

    function switchIdentityMode(mode) {
        var camMode = document.getElementById('identityCameraMode');
        var uplMode = document.getElementById('identityUploadMode');
        var btnCam = document.getElementById('btnCameraMode');
        var btnUpl = document.getElementById('btnUploadMode');

        if (mode === 'camera') {
            camMode.classList.remove('hidden');
            uplMode.classList.add('hidden');
            btnCam.className = 'flex-1 bg-brand-olive text-white text-xs tracking-widest uppercase py-3 rounded hover:bg-[#1c2001] transition-colors font-medium';
            btnUpl.className = 'flex-1 bg-brand-cream text-brand-olive text-xs tracking-widest uppercase py-3 rounded hover:bg-brand-border transition-colors font-medium';
        } else {
            camMode.classList.add('hidden');
            uplMode.classList.remove('hidden');
            btnCam.className = 'flex-1 bg-brand-cream text-brand-olive text-xs tracking-widest uppercase py-3 rounded hover:bg-brand-border transition-colors font-medium';
            btnUpl.className = 'flex-1 bg-brand-olive text-white text-xs tracking-widest uppercase py-3 rounded hover:bg-[#1c2001] transition-colors font-medium';
            stopIdentityCamera();
        }
    }

    function setIdentityCameraMessage(message) {
        var messageEl = document.getElementById('identityCameraMessage');
        if (messageEl) {
            messageEl.textContent = message;
            messageEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        }
        if (window.showToast) {
            window.showToast(message, 'error');
        }
    }

    function switchToIdentityUploadFallback(message) {
        setIdentityCameraMessage(message);
        switchIdentityMode('upload');
    }

    function getCameraErrorMessage(err) {
        if (!err || !err.name) return cameraMessages.failed;
        if (err.name === 'NotAllowedError' || err.name === 'PermissionDeniedError' || err.name === 'SecurityError') return cameraMessages.denied;
        if (err.name === 'NotFoundError' || err.name === 'DevicesNotFoundError') return cameraMessages.notFound;
        if (err.name === 'NotReadableError' || err.name === 'TrackStartError' || err.name === 'AbortError') return cameraMessages.busy;
        return cameraMessages.failed;
    }

    function startIdentityCamera() {
        var video = document.getElementById('identityVideo');
        var placeholder = document.getElementById('identityCameraPlaceholder');
        var startBtn = document.getElementById('btnStartCamera');
        var captureBtn = document.getElementById('btnCapturePhoto');
        var messageEl = document.getElementById('identityCameraMessage');
        if (messageEl) messageEl.classList.add('hidden');

        if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
            switchToIdentityUploadFallback(cameraMessages.unsupported);
            return;
        }

        if (!window.isSecureContext && location.hostname !== 'localhost') {
            switchToIdentityUploadFallback(cameraMessages.insecure);
            return;
        }

        navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
            video: { facingMode: { ideal: 'environment' }, width: { ideal: 1280 }, height: { ideal: 960 } },
            audio: false
        })
            .then(function(stream) {
                identityStream = stream;
                video.srcObject = stream;
                return video.play();
            })
            .then(function() {
                placeholder.classList.add('hidden');
                startBtn.classList.add('hidden');
                captureBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                stopIdentityCamera();
                switchToIdentityUploadFallback(getCameraErrorMessage(err));
            });
    }

    function captureIdentityPhoto() {
        var video = document.getElementById('identityVideo');
        var canvas = document.getElementById('identityCanvas');

        canvas.width = video.videoWidth || 1280;
        canvas.height = video.videoHeight || 960;
        var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        canvas.toBlob(function(blob) {
            if (!blob) {
                switchToIdentityUploadFallback(cameraMessages.failed);
                return;
            }
            var previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            uploadIdentityPhoto(blob, 'captured-id-' + Date.now() + '.jpg', previewUrl);
        }, 'image/jpeg', 0.92);
    }

    function uploadIdentityPhoto(blob, fileName, previewUrl) {
        var formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('dosya', blob, fileName);

        var token = document.querySelector('input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]')?.value;
        var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhr.open('POST', '/checkout/YukleKimlikFoto', true);
        if (token) {
            xhr.setRequestHeader('RequestVerificationToken', token);
        }
        xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Checkout-Upload-Token', checkoutUploadToken);

        xhr.onload = function() {
            if (xhr.status === 200) {
                try {
                    var response = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                    if (response.success) {
                        document.getElementById('KimlikFotoYolu').value = response.url;
                        showIdentityPreview(previewUrl);
                        if (window.showToast) {
                            window.showToast('@Localizer["IdentityPhotoUploaded"]', 'success');
                        }
                        stopIdentityCamera();
                        showIdentityControlsAfterCapture();
                    } else {
                        if (window.showToast) {
                            window.showToast(response.message || cameraMessages.uploadFailed, 'error');
                        }
                    }
                } catch(e) {
                    if (window.showToast) {
                        window.showToast(cameraMessages.uploadFailed, 'error');
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if (window.showToast) {
                    window.showToast(cameraMessages.uploadFailed, 'error');
                }
            }
        };

        xhr.onerror = function() {
            if (window.showToast) {
                window.showToast(cameraMessages.uploadFailed, 'error');
            }
        };

        xhr.send(formData);
    }

    function togglePaymentMethod(method) {
        var bankAccountsSection = document.getElementById('bankAccountsSection');
        var checkoutCodSurchargeSatiri = document.getElementById('checkoutCodSurchargeSatiri');

        if (method === 'KapidaOdeme') {
            if (bankAccountsSection) bankAccountsSection.classList.add('hidden');
            if (checkoutCodSurchargeSatiri) checkoutCodSurchargeSatiri.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            if (bankAccountsSection) bankAccountsSection.classList.remove('hidden');
            if (checkoutCodSurchargeSatiri) checkoutCodSurchargeSatiri.classList.add('hidden');
        }

        var isStorePickup = document.querySelector('input[name="TeslimatTipi"]:checked')?.value === 'MagazadanTeslim';
        if (!isStorePickup && typeof sehirKargoHesapla === 'function') {
            sehirKargoHesapla();
        }
    }

    function showIdentityPreview(url) {
        var preview = document.getElementById('identityPreview');
        var container = document.getElementById('identityPreviewContainer');
        if (identityPreviewObjectUrl) {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(identityPreviewObjectUrl);
            identityPreviewObjectUrl = null;
        }
        if (url && url.startsWith('blob:')) {
            identityPreviewObjectUrl = url;
        }
        preview.src = url;
        container.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function showIdentityControlsAfterCapture() {
        var captureBtn = document.getElementById('btnCapturePhoto');
        var retakeBtn = document.getElementById('btnRetakePhoto');
        captureBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        retakeBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function retakeIdentityPhoto() {
        var preview = document.getElementById('identityPreviewContainer');
        var retakeBtn = document.getElementById('btnRetakePhoto');
        var startBtn = document.getElementById('btnStartCamera');
        var captureBtn = document.getElementById('btnCapturePhoto');
        var hiddenInput = document.getElementById('KimlikFotoYolu');

        preview.classList.add('hidden');
        retakeBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        hiddenInput.value = '';
        startBtn.classList.remove('hidden');

        startIdentityCamera();
    }

    function stopIdentityCamera() {
        if (identityStream) {
            identityStream.getTracks().forEach(function(track) {
                track.stop();
            });
            identityStream = null;
        }
        var video = document.getElementById('identityVideo');
        if (video) {
            video.srcObject = null;
        }
    }

    function handleIdentityFileUpload(input) {
        if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
            var file = input.files[0];

            if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
                if (window.showToast) {
                    window.showToast('@Localizer["Siparis_FileUploadError"]', 'error');
                }
                return;
            }

            var previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
            uploadIdentityPhoto(file, file.name, previewUrl);
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function() {
        stopIdentityCamera();
    });

    // --- Dinamik Kargo Hesaplama (Şehir Bazlı) ---
    function sehirKargoHesapla() {
        const isStorePickup = document.querySelector('input[name="TeslimatTipi"]:checked')?.value === 'MagazadanTeslim';
        if (isStorePickup) return;

        const sehir = document.getElementById("Sehir")?.value;
        if (!sehir) return;

        const url = "/checkout/shipping-cost?sehir=" + encodeURIComponent(sehir);

        fetch(url)
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(data => {
                const pickupSelected = document.querySelector('input[name="TeslimatTipi"]:checked')?.value === 'MagazadanTeslim';
                if (pickupSelected) return;

                if (data.success) {
                    const kargoDisplay = document.getElementById("checkoutKargoUcreti");
                    const totalDisplay = document.getElementById("checkoutGenelToplam");
                    const btnTotalDisplay = document.getElementById("checkoutBtnTotal");
                    const checkoutKargoSatiri = document.getElementById("checkoutKargoSatiri");
                    const freeShippingBanner = document.getElementById("checkoutFreeShippingBanner");

                    const araToplam = parseFloat("@((araToplam - indirim).ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))");
                    const codBedel = parseFloat("@codBedel.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)");
                    const selectedPayment = document.querySelector('input[name="odemeYontemi"]:checked')?.value || 'BankaHavalesi';
                    const codPrice = (selectedPayment === 'KapidaOdeme') ? codBedel : 0;

                    // Kargo ücretini güncelle
                    const isFree = data.kargoUcreti <= 0 || araToplam >= data.ucretsizKargoLimiti;
                    const gecerliKargoUcreti = isFree ? 0 : data.kargoUcreti;

                    if (kargoDisplay) {
                        if (gecerliKargoUcreti === 0) {
                            kargoDisplay.textContent = '@Localizer["Free"]';
                            kargoDisplay.className = "text-green-600 font-bold uppercase";
                        } else {
                            kargoDisplay.textContent = currencySymbol + formatCheckoutNumber(gecerliKargoUcreti);
                            kargoDisplay.className = "text-brand-olive font-medium";
                        }
                    }

                    // Free shipping banner güncelleme
                    const kalanTutar = data.ucretsizKargoLimiti - araToplam;
                    if (checkoutFreeShippingBanner) {
                        if (kalanTutar > 0) {
                            checkoutFreeShippingBanner.innerHTML =
                                '<div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-amber-800 mb-3">' +
                                '<i class="fas fa-truck text-brand-gold"></i>' +
                                '<span>' + formatCheckoutNumber(kalanTutar) + ' ' + currencySymbol + ' @Localizer["FreeShippingAbove"]</span></div>' +
                                '<div class="w-full h-2 bg-amber-200 rounded-full overflow-hidden">' +
                                '<div class="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#b58735] to-[#d4a84b] rounded-full" style="width: ' + Math.min(100, Math.round((araToplam / data.ucretsizKargoLimiti) * 100)) + '%"></div></div>';
                            checkoutFreeShippingBanner.className = "mb-5 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg p-4";
                        } else {
                            checkoutFreeShippingBanner.innerHTML =
                                '<div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-green-800">' +
                                '<i class="fas fa-check-circle text-green-500"></i>' +
                                '<span class="font-semibold">@Localizer["FreeShippingReached"]</span></div>';
                            checkoutFreeShippingBanner.className = "mb-5 bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-lg p-4";
                        }
                        checkoutFreeShippingBanner.classList.remove('hidden');
                    }

                    // Total güncelle
                    const genelToplamVal = araToplam + gecerliKargoUcreti + codPrice;
                    if (totalDisplay) {
                        totalDisplay.innerHTML = formatCheckoutNumber(genelToplamVal) + ' <span class="text-lg font-normal text-brand-mutedtext">' + currencySymbol + '</span>';
                    }
                    if (btnTotalDisplay) {
                        btnTotalDisplay.textContent = formatCheckoutNumber(genelToplamVal);
                    }
                }
            })
            .catch(err => console.error("Kargo hesaplama hatası:", err));
    }

    // Şehir değişince kargo hesapla
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const sehirSelect = document.getElementById("Sehir");
        if (sehirSelect) {
            sehirSelect.addEventListener("change", sehirKargoHesapla);
        }
    });

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const kargoDisplay = document.getElementById("checkoutKargoUcreti");
        const totalDisplay = document.getElementById("checkoutGenelToplam");
        const btnTotalDisplay = document.getElementById("checkoutBtnTotal");
        const subtotal = parseFloat("@((araToplam - indirim).ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))");
        const codBedel = parseFloat("@codBedel.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)");
        const codLimit = parseFloat("@codLimit.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)");

        function updateCheckoutTotals() {
            const isStorePickup = document.querySelector('input[name="TeslimatTipi"]:checked')?.value === 'MagazadanTeslim';

            const codPaymentOption = document.getElementById('codPaymentOption');
            if (subtotal > codLimit) {
                if (codPaymentOption) {
                    codPaymentOption.classList.add('hidden');
                    var bankRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="odemeYontemi"][value="BankaHavalesi"]');
                    if (bankRadio && bankRadio.checked === false) {
                        bankRadio.checked = true;
                        togglePaymentMethod('BankaHavalesi');
                    }
                }
            } else if (!isStorePickup) {
                if (codPaymentOption) codPaymentOption.classList.remove('hidden');
            }

            const selectedPayment = document.querySelector('input[name="odemeYontemi"]:checked')?.value || 'BankaHavalesi';
            const codPrice = (selectedPayment === 'KapidaOdeme' && !isStorePickup) ? codBedel : 0;

            // Kargo ücreti için mevcut görünen değeri al (şehir bazlı hesaplama zaten yapıldıysa)
            const mevcutKargo = kargoDisplay ? kargoDisplay.textContent : (isStorePickup ? '0.00 ' + currencySymbol : currencySymbol + '0.00');
            let kargoPrice = 0;
            if (!isStorePickup) {
                const txt = mevcutKargo.replace(currencySymbol, '').replace(/[^0-9.,]/g, '').replace(',', '.');
                kargoPrice = parseFloat(txt) || 0;
            }

            const genelToplamVal = subtotal + kargoPrice + codPrice;

            if (kargoDisplay) {
                if (isStorePickup) {
                    kargoDisplay.textContent = currencySymbol + formatCheckoutNumber(0);
                    kargoDisplay.className = "text-brand-olive font-medium";
                }
            }

            if (totalDisplay) {
                totalDisplay.innerHTML = formatCheckoutNumber(genelToplamVal) + ' <span class="text-lg font-normal text-brand-mutedtext">' + currencySymbol + '</span>';
            }

            if (btnTotalDisplay) {
                btnTotalDisplay.textContent = formatCheckoutNumber(genelToplamVal);
            }
        }

        // COD payment method change listener
        const codRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="odemeYontemi"]');
        codRadios.forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener("change", function() {
                updateCheckoutTotals();
                sehirKargoHesapla();
            });
        });

        updateCheckoutTotals();
        toggleDeliveryType();
        const selectedPayment = document.querySelector('input[name="odemeYontemi"]:checked');
        if (selectedPayment) togglePaymentMethod(selectedPayment.value);
    });

    function copyIban(elementId, btn) {
        const el = document.getElementById(elementId);
        if (!el) return;
        const text = el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, '');
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
            const icon = btn.querySelector('i');
            if (icon) {
                icon.className = 'fas fa-check text-sm';
                setTimeout(() => { icon.className = 'fas fa-copy text-sm'; }, 2000);
            }
        });
    }
</script>

@functions {
    string FormatIban(string iban)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(iban)) return "";
        var clean = iban.Replace(" ", "");
        var parts = new List<string>();
        for (int i = 0; i < clean.Length; i += 4)
            parts.Add(clean.Substring(i, Math.Min(4, clean.Length - i)));
        return string.Join(" ", parts);
    }
}
